course.titleZh: 大型跨國調查資料之分析與應用
course.titleEn: Analysis and Application of Large-Scale International Survey Data
course.description:
Have you ever wondered if people in different countries really live differently? They often think differently about family, work, money, trust, happiness, and politics. They may also behave differently, follow different ways of life, and reach different results in education and health. For example, how many hours do people work, and are shorter working hours linked to more happiness? How do couples share housework across countries? How healthy do people stay as they grow older? And how well do students do in math and science in different school systems and education cultures? In this course, we use real survey data collected from people all around the world to study questions like these.
You will work with several famous international survey projects, including the World Values Survey (WVS), the East Asian Social Survey (EASS), the International Social Survey Programme (ISSP), the Programme for International Student Assessment (PISA), and the WHO Study on Global AGEing and Adult Health (SAGE).
This course gives you the tools to study that world with real evidence. Step by step, you will learn how these surveys are made, how to clean and prepare the data, how to compare answers fairly across countries, and how to turn your results into a clear report and a short presentation.
You do not need to be a “statistics person” to do well here. We start from the basics and build up slowly. Every new idea comes with a hands-on example, and we review the key statistics together in class before you need to use them. Class demonstrations use R (and Python templates will also be shared), but you may use any software you like for your own work, including R, Python, Stata, SAS, or SPSS. There are no required prerequisites. Having taken (or currently taking) an introductory statistics or research methods course is helpful, but it is not mandatory.
The skills you build here are useful far beyond the classroom and beyond academic research. You will learn how to work with large and messy real-world data, how to ask a clear question and find the answer in the numbers, how to make simple charts and tables that tell a story, and how to explain your findings to people who are not experts.
course.objectives:
By the end of the course, students will be able to:
Understand how the major international surveys (WVS, EASS, ISSP, PISA, and SAGE) are built, and why they are useful for studying how people think, behave, live, and learn in different countries.
Prepare and clean real survey data, and run basic to intermediate analysis using the software of your choice.
Ask a clear research question and test it with care, while watching for common problems in comparing countries (for example, sampling, and whether a question means the same thing in each country).
Write and present your own short research that compares countries or studies a topic in an international setting.
Turn data into a clear story: make simple charts and tables, draw honest conclusions, and explain your findings to people who are not experts.

Technical innovation has the potency to significantly alter the economic and military landscape. Thus, the US and China are competing over the next breed of technology since the year of 2018. New national level regulation on technology transfer such as export control and restriction on foreign investment are being rolled out by the US, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, Taiwan, and China itself as well. Taiwan, as one of the most critical tech hubs of global tech supply chain, is becoming one of the key players of these grand competition in the coming era of geo-technology. Our future decision makers from government to enterprise need to be cultivated more knowledge and strategy to take charge the leadership of Taiwan’s leading technology, economy and sovereignty.
Therefore, our discussions focus especially on recent legal and policy issues related to the grand transformation of global geo-technological environment: technology law and policies related to resent geo-technological trends focus on the US-China high-tech competition and impact of the reconstructing of global tech supply chain, the rising idea of implementing regulation to protect cutting edge technology through reforms on security export control, investigation and restriction on foreign investment, data and information protection, intellectual property and trade secret from an intersectional perspective.

Describe how regulation & policy is done in the "real word" by its practitioners.
Write effectively for policy situations, both in short fact sheets and longer reports.

Work effectively in teams.

course.description:
Sustainable development has been ardently advocated by numerous international institutions, governments, NGOs, and corporations in recent years. Despite its growing prominence, the concept of sustainable development is broad and complex. One illustrative example of its scope is the United Nations' 17 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). These cover a wide array of interconnected objectives, ranging from poverty eradication and climate action, to ensuring inclusive education and beyond.
Navigating these multifaceted and often nebulous concepts can pose a significant challenge. The tasks of defining these goals, assessing progress, and crafting effective strategies are no small feats. Yet, the advent of advanced data analysis tools and techniques provides a promising pathway to address these complex issues. Especially in the recent years, GenAI's development has offered opportunities for the analysis of sustainable issues.
course.objectives:
This course is designed to illuminate this intersection. Its goal is to equip students with the necessary knowledge and skills to apply data analysis in the context of sustainable development. Through this journey, students will cultivate a robust understanding of how to define, evaluate, and address sustainable development goals using data-driven approaches and AI agents.
This course is designed to leverage data analysis in order to evaluate the ways in which various groups and classes mobilize to promote their agendas, ultimately impacting the progress of sustainable development. These social actors encompass corporations, trade associations, social classes, racial and ethnic groups, as well as the state. Through this course, you will embark on a journey into a dynamic and rapidly evolving field that has the potential to drive significant change on corporate, national, and even global levels.

course.titleEn: The Political Economy of China's Development
course.description: This course aims to provide students with a fundamental understanding of China's economic, social, and political development since 1978. Four main themes are involved. The first is the introduction. We will introduce this course with a discussion on the universality and particularity of the "China Model" from a comparative perspective. The second theme is economic transformation. We will explore China's industrialization and engagement with the world economy after the 1978 reform and opening up by examining the roles of the central government, local governments, the financial system, the fiscal system, state-owned enterprises, private enterprises, and foreign enterprises. The third theme is social changes. We will investigate the impacts that economic transformation brought to society in many aspects, including the urban-rural divide, social stratification, the one-child policy and its impact on demographics, as well as environmental issues. The fourth theme is political development. We will explore the implications of economic development for the prospect of democracy in China, as well as the impact that China's rise might bring to international political development. Moreover, we will show to and discuss with students selected movies related to the topics in the course, with an aim to improve students' understanding of some critical scenarios in the processes of China's political and economic development.
course.objectives: Students will be equipped with the ability to interpret and analyze the causes, logic, and consequences of China's political and economic development. Considering the current trend of China's rise, such capacity will be beneficial to students' career development whether in academic circles or practical fields.

course.description:
This course is designed to introduce to undergraduate and postgraduate students the pertinent economic theories and their applications to contemporary environmental problems. We will firstly introduce the Economics-based analytical approaches for environmental studies. We particularly focus on contemporary environmental issues such as pollution, greenhouse gases emissions and virtual trade of natural resources. Secondly we will discuss the literature on the nexus between trade, national economy and sustainability. Countries derive additional economic benefits from trade than otherwise, for example, with augmented domestic production. Natural environment and resources are used as input for producing exported goods (or to accommodate pollutants discharged from the production process). However, environmental stress concomitant with the economic boom was not properly attended nor charged. Typical of such case, Asian-Pacific economies are attracting the world’s attention in their rapid economic growth, sizable markets and increasingly significant role in the global economy. Domestic and global factors have together shaped the diverse economies in this region, particularly in their economic structure and development pathways and strategies. Inextricably linked with economic activities, environmental quality and natural resource endowment in this region are facing tremendous stress from far and near. Developed and developing countries of this region share a common development experience by thriving their economies on trade, though now even more intensive globalization. Sustainable development in both the economy and environment is thus concerned. A good grasp of the economy-environment nexus from both economy-wide and world-wide perspectives is imperative and helpful in guiding pertinent policies to effectively tackle the dual challenge of sustainability transition.
The course participants are encouraged to get involved in the discussion on issues and analyses particularly from the perspectives of economics, and to summarize in the form of academic writing the insights and policy implications derived from the literature review. Students will form small groups to present and discuss on selected papers. Presentations of the group projects by the students on their literature review of pertinent theories, applications and policy assessment will culminate with the course.
The topics we will review of literature centering the nexus of trade, economy and the environment, mainly from economic perspectives, are:
The nexus between trade, economy and the environment,
Environment impact of economic activities,
Natural resource leakage from developing countries,
Economic development pathways and strategies of the developed countries, and their experiences in managing the concomitant environmental stress,
Economic analysis on policies for correcting negative externality of economic activities, and
Measures proposed for green growth.
The participants will get experience in doing academic literature review and writing-up, in addition to the knowledge of trade and environmental economic theories.

course.description:
貿易政策的議題，在傳統上，是聚焦在政府應否對外開放其本國的自由貿易、或應否對貿易作某種管制的討論上。而無論哪一種政策工具，一旦施行，便不可避免地會國際市場的供需產生或多或少的影響，也因此會影響到貿易的價格、貿易的數量、國內的生產、國內的消費、乃至所得分配等等的面向，而最終也將會影響到社會福利。
The issues of trade policy are traditionally focused on whether the government should open its domestic market, or whether certain types of restrictions should be implemented. Once implemented, any type of trade policy tool will inevitably more or less affect the demand and supply of international market, and hence affect the prices and quantities of trade, domestic consumption, and income distribution, among others, and at last affect the social welfare.
course.objectives:
本課程以貿易理論為其基礎，以探討貿易政策在國際貿易各個面向中的角色，及其最終對社會福利的影響。在學習完本課程後，你將可以：
一：瞭解政府干預國際貿易的動機，並理解各類的干預手段諸如關稅、配額、出口補貼、出口自動設限等的運作機制。
二：瞭解開發中國家及工業化國家兩類國家常見的貿易政策，並明白其利弊得失。
三：瞭解世界貿易組織對國際貿易的規範，及其對本國的影響。另外也會能瞭解國際上最流行的區域貿易協定的議題。
This course explores, on the basis of the theories of trade, the role of trade policies in various aspects of international trade, and their effects on social welfare. The content of this course can be divided into three parts:
1. I will first talk about the government’s incentives to intervene in international trade, and then introduce various policy tools such as tariffs, quotas, export subsidies, VER (Voluntary Export Restraint), and so on.
2. I will introduce common trade policies implemented by developing and developed countries, and discuss their pros and cons.
3. I will talk about some rules set by the WTO for international trade, and discuss their effects on domestic country. Other issues frequently discussed recently such as regional free trade agreement (FTA) will also be mentioned if time allows.

course.description:
Occupational health psychology (OHP) is an interdisciplinary field of study that aims to improve the quality of work life and to promote the safety, health, and well-being of workers in all occupations. This course introduces fundamental theories and explores findings from cutting-edge research in industrial/organizational psychology, health psychology, and public/occupational health.
The objective of this course is to provide students with a thorough understanding of the various factors that affect workers’ physical and psychological health as well as safety and well-being (individual psychological attributes, job contents and work organization, organizational policies and practices, etc.) and to apply the knowledge to health safety, and well-being issues in the modern workplace.
This class is organized around the following themes: (1) an introduction to the foundations of occupational health psychology and Total Worker Health, (2) how the design and demands of jobs create health risks, (3) how social relationships and organizational contexts shape worker well-being, (4) how broader work systems and emerging forms of work influence occupational health, and (5) how organizations can design, evaluate, and justify evidence-based interventions to create healthier work.
This course takes a participatory approach. You will engage in a variety of learning activities, including lectures, hands-on activities, team/class discussions, case studies, and presentations. Each week, mini-lectures will highlight the conceptual foundations and practical implications of key theories and principles in occupational health psychology, rather than “covering” everything in the readings. Hands-on activities, team/class discussions, and case studies will help you apply important concepts from the readings and develop skills to analyze and manage problems that related to workers’ health, safety, and well-being in real-life settings. You are expected to read all assigned materials
prior to class
, attend every class, and actively participate in class activities. All assignments should be submitted by the stated deadline; late assignments will be accepted only in accordance with the course late-submission policy and may receive a significant grade reduction.
course.objectives:
By the end of this course, you will be able to:
describe fundamental theories and recent empirical research in the field of occupational health psychology.
apply scientific knowledge to practical health, safety, and well-being issues in the modern workplace.
design solutions to improve the quality of work life and promote workers’ health.
communicate competently to an academic or professional audience via both written and oral presentations.

course.description:
A major component of the course involves mastering brand positioning—the art and science of differentiating a brand in a crowded market. Students will examine successful brand positioning strategies and learn how to craft strong, resonant brand identities that capture consumer attention and loyalty.
In addition to building brands, students will also learn to assess and measure brand equity, using key frameworks such as Keller’s Customer-Based Brand Equity (CBBE) model. Brand equity measurement will include understanding the strength of consumer-brand relationships, brand associations, and overall market performance. Through this, students will gain a comprehensive understanding of how brands maintain relevance and value over time.
The course is highly practical, with two core project components: brand audits and brand strategy development. In the brand audit project, students will choose a real-world brand to analyze, conducting a thorough review of its performance, market positioning, and consumer perception. The audit will serve as a foundation for the subsequent brand plan, where students will apply their insights to create a strategic and data-driven brand management plan.
Students will not only have a solid understanding of the theoretical aspects of brand management, but they will also be equipped with practical skills to develop and implement effective, long-term brand strategies. This combination of theory and practice will prepare students for future roles in marketing, brand management, or consulting, where strategic brand thinking is essential.
course.objectives: In this course, students will build upon the foundational knowledge acquired in their Marketing Management course, focusing on practical applications in product and brand management. The primary aim is to enhance students’ understanding of the consumer decision-making process and their ability to identify and interpret key customer insights. Students will explore the consumer decision-making process, brand positioning, brand equity measurement, and strategy development through brand audits and brand plans. By the end of the course, students will be able to develop a comprehensive, data-driven brand strategy.

course.description: Macroeconomics is concerned with the behavior of the economy as a whole. It is the study of relationships and linkages among economic variables that affect the aggregate level of output, employment, prices and interest rates in all markets. Built upon the foundations developed in the Principles of Economics, this course breaks down complicated details of the macroeconomy into a few manageable essentials. These essentials lie in the interactions between three major markets: the goods market, the assets market and the labor market. Key topics include aggregate supply and aggregate demand; goods market, asset market, and some basics of monetary and fiscal policy; current issues in macroeconomic policy-making; and the financial market.
course.objectives: The goal of the course is to develop a coherent theoretical framework for thinking about the determination of macroeconomic variables: the aggregate level of output, employment, prices, interest rates and economic growth. This theoretical framework is then used to interpret macroeconomic data and to analyze macroeconomic policy. Upon completion the course, students should be to be able to use economic reasoning in a meaningful way when discussing current economic problems published in magazines & newspapers such as: the Economist, and the Wall Street Journal.

course.description: 貿易源於消費者將消費平均分配於不同物品的傾向，以及不同物品的生產，不平均地分配在不同地點。前者似乎和人的天性有關，而後者的成因較為複雜。貿易理論首在解釋生產活動無法平均分佈於不同地點的成因，進而勾勒出物品在不同地點及空間流動的方向 (貿易型態)。商品的流動滿足了人類平均消費的需要，也提升了生活的水準 (福利)。在理解商品流動的原因後，政府應採取何種政策調控商品流動的數量 (貿易政策) 將成為另一個討論的主題。

This course takes a data-driven approach to making investment decisions. The first part will review financial market basics, essential mathematical tools (linear algebra, constrained optimization), statistical methods (linear regression, simulation), Excel spreadsheets, and Python programming (NumPy, SciPy, and Pandas) for investment analysis.  The second part will introduce the quantitative investment framework: (i) data collection, (ii) input estimation, (iii) portfolio optimization, (iv) back-testing, (v) implementation, and (vi) performance evaluation. Students will learn how to apply financial theories in portfolio choice (MPT) and asset pricing (CAPM). For practical topics, the course will cover the fund industry, passive investing, active portfolio management, factor investing, performance metrics, style analysis, and risk management.
Students should have a
good background
in
mathematics and statistics
(e.g.,
matrix operations, univariate calculus, normal distribution, hypothesis testing
).
Prior knowledge in programming
(e.g., Python, R, Excel VBA, Matlab, etc.) is
desirable but not required
.
Students without the aforementioned knowledge should expect a steep learning curve and heavy workload.

4.    To gain awareness of the limitations of theoretical models in reality.
5.    To learn about the investment management industry and performance evaluation.
6.    To gain insights about trends in investment and portfolio management.

course.description:
This course provides an overview of the strategic sales force management process, with particular emphasis on the formulation, implementation, and evaluation of sales programs. Rather than focusing on the interpersonal selling process or "how to sell," the course examines how organizations strategically design, lead, and manage salespeople, sales teams, and customer relationships in business-to-business (B2B) markets.
Topics include sales force recruitment, training, compensation, performance evaluation, motivation, leadership, territory management, and ethical decision-making. Through case discussions, managerial decision-making exercises, and simulations, students will develop the ability to think from the perspective of sales managers and organizational leaders. The course emphasizes both analytical decision-making and the human side of leading high-performing sales organizations.
This course incorporates the
Cantopia Sales Force Management Simulation
, an interactive platform that enables students to apply sales management concepts through experiential, team-based decision-making. Throughout the simulation, students will manage a virtual sales force and make strategic decisions regarding recruitment, compensation, territory allocation, workload management, and leadership.
course.objectives:
COURSE OBJECTIVES
The primary goal of this course is to examine the strategic role of sales force management as a critical component of an organization’s overall marketing effort. Emphasis is placed on how firms create customer value through effective sales leadership, relationship management, and sales strategy implementation. Specifically, this course aims to:
Introduce students to the evolving roles and responsibilities of contemporary salespeople and sales managers in today’s competitive business environment.
Develop students’ ability to make strategic sales management decisions using relevant business information, analytical frameworks, and managerial judgment.
Strengthen students’ ability to critically analyze and solve complex sales management challenges through evidence-based decision-making.
Enhance students’ communication, collaboration, leadership, and problem-solving skills through case discussions, applied learning activities, and managerial simulations.
Provide students with practical insights into professional selling and sales management careers while fostering ethical and customer-oriented leadership.
LEARNING OUTCOMES
By the end of this course, students will be able to:
Demonstrate foundational knowledge of sales management concepts, frameworks, and terminology.
Analyze sales management problems and develop strategic, evidence-based recommendations.
Evaluate sales force strategies, leadership decisions, and organizational performance using critical thinking and relevant business information.
Communicate sales management analyses and strategic recommendations effectively through professional written and oral presentations.
Apply appropriate technologies, business data, and performance metrics to support sales management decision-making.
Demonstrate ethical, global, and cultural awareness when evaluating sales management practices and organizational decisions.
Collaborate effectively in team settings to solve complex sales management problems.

course.description:
Please note ITS course is NOT an EMI course and is conducted in Mandarin.
This is an online interactive simulation course of international trade. Students in NCCU, FSU (Florida State University College of Law) and SUIBE (Shanghai University of International Business & Economics) will simultaneously participate in the simulated trade transactions with one another.  Using a web-based software platform designed just for this course, students will play the roles of virtual trading companies in their respective areas and seek to trade goods between Taiwan/USA and Taiwan/Shanghai.
Trade Simulation, Business Review, Quiz and Board Meeting are the four segments of this course.
-
Trade Simulation
Basically, every 3 students will make up a team and register a virtual company of their own. By browsing the ITS platform, students can be well informed of the domestic and overseas demand and supply, and then to decide what to sell or buy. Facing various situations in the trading environment, students will learn how to acquire competitive advantages, control business risks, so as to maximize trade profits. Gradually, keen market awareness, strong communication skills, good team spirit, rapid response style and logical analysis ability have been trained during the learning-by-doing process. During the simulation, the participants communicate mainly by E-mails with foreign counterparts. Moreover, real-time oral negotiations are conducted via live conference facilities among 3 ends.
-
Business Review
During trade simulation, students will have weekly class meetings with the instructors to summarize and self-assess their own operations. The week's transactions will be reviewed, and any problems that cropped up can be analyzed and solved. Besides, effective communications within the team will also be strengthened.
-
Quiz
A couple of quizzes will be held close to the end of the class, so as to find out how much each student has learned from the class.
-
Board Meeting
At the end of simulation, students will write working reports according to their business achievements and submit to the board in advance. On the board meeting,
students
will give presentations to the
board
directors
,
which are
composed of professional and experienced people from trading industry
,
and accept their questions and comments.
course.objectives:
Both classroom-based and electronic formats are used.  Students at NCCU, FSU and SUIBE log in the program regularly to receive news about trading opportunities, and perform tasks outlined in the program that advance their trades.  A manual is available on the ITS platform, together with 3 hours each week of supervised trading and question-and-answer sessions.  Students will negotiate in live video sessions, email or by other communication apps, and also regularly maintain online records of their virtual company’s transactions, in order to track the results of their deals and what they have learned about international trade.
A primary objective of the course is to help students learn how to conduct an international trade transaction.
To that end, we will take a hands-on approach.  Through simulations accessible in a specially-designed internet environment, you will perform all the major tasks of actual international trade transactions, including 1) finding a seller of a product you want to buy, 2) negotiating the terms of the purchase, 3) arranging for financing, shipping, and insurance, and 4) keeping track of the financial effects of the transaction on your company.  We also emphasize a problem-solving approach.  You will learn to identify risks and challenges and also how to develop strategies to solve them.
Another objective of the course is to introduce you to future clients and contacts.
FSU and SUIBE students will soon be staff of important companies which engage in foreign trade.  Not only will you meet them through this course, you will also get to know them further through weekly contact with them and learn how to engage them effectively.  Building such relationships is of crucial importance to international business.

course.description:
Negotiation has been defined as the art of letting the other person have it your way! Can you get the deal you want whilst making your opponent feel the same?
This course is composed of 8 modules which provide a wide spectrum of coverage for those who seek excellence in both negotiation skills as well as in business English skills.
What is the worst thing you can do to a negotiator? What does grammar have to do with business etiquette of diplomacy? What is the difference between negotiating positions and interests? And what are the six principles of persuasion you should follow to make any negotiator much more likely to say yes?
You will discover the answers to these and many other questions about international negotiations by taking part in some challenging role plays and skill-building games, and by practicing the art of asking probing questions and of disagreeing without being too direct.
In this course you will know when to take the lead and when to wait and see what the other side offers first. You will also learn how to decode typical body language signals, defend yourself against unethical tactics and boost your own persuasiveness.
Meanwhile, the issue of cultural differences will be raised as well to bring up learners’ awareness on how other cultures may have an impact on their approaches to international business situations.
course.objectives: This course is designated to develop excellence in international business negotiations skills and to improve your command of the formal business English you need to negotiate skillfully and fluently.

course.description:

1986
年烏拉圭回合談判才展開。由於至今不過才
30

另一方面，其多邊規範建立之初固然是仿照貨品貿易規範，但由於服務之無形，以及服務提供者角色之重要，也使得服務貿易規範與貨品貿易規範有相當多不同之處。再加以服務貿易之主要障礙並非在邊境，而是在國內規章，不僅導致貿易統計資料不易蒐集，自由化之推動也因涉及各國之國內法規而相對困難。
了解上述問題，並掌握規範之發展趨勢：包括雙邊、複邊與多邊場域已有之進展即為本課程之重點
course.objectives:
Learning what the trade in services is.
Learning the structure of the General Agreement on Trade in Services
Learning the legal perspectives of service trade
Learning the negotiations of service trade
Understanding the future development of the service trade rules

課程目標及學習收穫
本課程主要介紹下列金融創新商品：
·
ETF（主動式 ETF、槓桿型 ETF、反向型 ETF、期貨型ETF、
選擇權策略型 Covered Call ETF
等）
·
共同基金（Covered Call 收益型基金、保本型基金、多重資產基金等）
·
銀行結構型商品（FCN 固定票息票券、DCI 雙元貨幣投資、TRF 等）
·
券商結構型商品（ELN 股票連結證券、ETN 指數投資證券等）
·
認購認售權證（牛熊證、重設型權證等）
·
可轉換公司債（CB、CBAS 可轉換公司債資產交換等）
·
債券商品（股價指數連動債券、高收益債券、信用連結債券等）
·
保險商品（投資型保單、巨災債券等）
·
加密資產（比特幣、以太幣、穩定幣等）

實體資產代幣化（Real-World Assets, RWA）（股票代幣化、債券代幣化、不動產代幣化等）
修習本課程後，學生應能：
了解金融創新商品之發展背景、設計理念及市場功能。
熟悉各類金融創新商品之產品架構、交易機制、定價原理、報酬來源及風險特性。
了解金融創新商品之定價概念、避險機制及風險管理方法，並能分析其投資價值及適用情境。
能閱讀並分析金融商品說明書及主要契約條款，理解商品設計邏輯、投資風險及相關法規要求。
能運用金融理論分析金融創新商品之風險與報酬特性，培養獨立分析及解決問題之能力。
了解銀行、券商、投信及保險公司等金融機構於金融創新商品之設計、發行、交易及風險管理之實務運作。
認識金融市場最新發展趨勢，包括主動式 ETF、加密資產、穩定幣及實體資產代幣化（Real-World Assets, RWA）等新興金融商品。
透過實際案例分析、金融業界專家演講及參訪證券商、投信公司與銀行等金融機構，了解金融創新商品之實務運作，培養整合理論與實務、分析問題及獨立思考之能力。

course.description: This course provides an advanced introduction to Financial Statement Analysis and its application to firm valuation. The primary objective is to equip students with the ability to interpret financial statements and use them to estimate the value of firms in a systematic and structured manner. While the course covers the fundamentals of financial statements, its main focus is on how accounting information can be translated into valuation inputs.
course.objectives: The course begins with an overview of the three core financial statements—income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow statement—and how they are used to assess firm performance and financial position. Building on this foundation, the course develops key valuation approaches. First, we study intrinsic valuation, focusing on the estimation of future cash flows, discount rates, and terminal value within the discounted cash flow (DCF) framework. Second, we examine relative valuation methods, including the use of multiples, asset-based valuation, and valuation of private companies. Finally, we introduce more advanced topics such as real option valuation, acquisition valuation, and value enhancement strategies. By the end of the course, students will be able to analyze financial statements and apply multiple valuation methods to assess firm value in a coherent and well-reasoned way.

course.description:
Sustainable finance has become inextricably integrated into the capital markets in order to support economic growth and reduce environment problem. The financial system is integral to achieving a smooth transition to a low carbon economy. Sustainable innovation is a process where sustainability considerations (environmental, social, financial) are integrated into company systems from idea generation through to research and development and commercialization. The course is designed to help the students gain an understanding of the sustainability development goals (SDGs), initiatives and regulations that support to develop the sustainable financial systems. This applies to products, services and technologies, as well as new business and organization model that are able to embed environmental, social and governance considerations. In addition, sustainable finance includes a strong green finance and climate finance components that aim to support economic growth while reducing pressures on the environment, addressing green-house gas emissions and tackling pollution, minimizing waste and improving efficiency in the use of natural resources. Therefore, we will also cover the full scope of sustainable finance providing an integrated view on investing, banking, and insurance
To absorb the knowledge and the experience of sustainable development from the leading financial institution, we will also invite their sustainable research teams to give lectures and mentoring the students in this course. They will cover and be arranged in the following fields:
1, 本課程將邀請業師參與授課
2, 本課程有期末專題發表補助
3, 本課程有永續金融證照補助
course.objectives:
The objective of this course is to integrate theory and application through the use of relevant case studies, reports and research papers. Students will become familiar with the main policies, regulations, frameworks, market initiatives, financial products and service to develop sustainable finance especially in green action today. The course will also explore the major obstacles and the opportunities facing the investors and financial institutions.
After taking this course, the student can develop their financial and problem-solving skills. In addition, the students shall have better management knowledge, global perspective, sustainable development and communication skill in ESG/SDG issues associated with financial markets

這門課過去是開在研究所的「理論」課程，雖然我會試圖講的簡單一些，但本質上這還是一門「不實用」的理論課，需要數學模型的推導。所以第一你要對數學模型的使用(主要就是微積分)不排斥，第二這是為興趣而上課，不太會有能直接應用的內容。所以選課前請仔細考慮。謝謝大家。

In particular, we will study the informational problems that arise in financial transaction and the ways in which financial intermediaries resolve these problems. We will discuss theories of financial crises to understand the nature of financial intermediation, the causes for bank runs and the prevention of financial crises.

course.description:
本課程旨在建立學生對機率論基本概念與理論架構之完整理解，並培養其數學推導與機率分析能力。課程內容包括組合分析、離散與連續型隨機變數、各類機率分配、期望值、變異數、動差生成函數、聯合分配、條件機率、獨立性及極限定理等主題，並透過例題與習題加強理論之應用與問題解決能力。修習本課程後，學生將具備進一步學習數理統計、資料科學及相關領域課程所需之機率理論基礎。教材採用 Sheldon Ross 所著
A First Course in Probability
，以其完整且循序漸進之內容作為本課程主要參考教材。
PS：課程所有加簽請於開學後第一週至課堂上進行。
course.objectives:
本課程旨在建立同學紮實的機率理論基礎，培養對隨機現象進行數學建模、分析與推論的能力。修習完成本課程後，同學應能夠：
理解機率論的基本公理、定義與重要原理。
運用組合分析方法計算有限樣本空間中的各類機率。
熟悉離散型與連續型隨機變數之機率分配，並能分析二項分配（Binomial）、卜瓦松分配（Poisson）、指數分配（Exponential）及常態分配（Normal）等重要分配。
計算隨機變數之期望值、變異數及高階動差等統計量。
分析聯合分配、邊際分配與條件分配，並能解決相關機率問題。
判斷隨機變數之獨立性，並熟練運用條件機率與條件期望等分析技巧。
運用動差生成函數（Moment Generating Function, MGF）推導機率分配及其動差。
理解並應用大數法則（Law of Large Numbers）與中央極限定理（Central Limit Theorem）等重要極限定理。
培養分析隨機現象與解決實際問題所需之機率推理與數學建模能力。
建立修習數理統計、隨機過程、機器學習及其他進階統計相關課程所需之理論基礎。
透過課堂講授、理論推導、例題分析及習題演練，學生將建立完整的機率概念，並具備運用機率理論分析與解決實務問題的能力。

course.description: 「程式設計與統計軟體」為統計學系專屬核心課程。本課程跳脫單純語法教學，透過 R 與 Python 實作機率分配、隨機抽樣、統計模擬與探索式資料分析，為迴歸分析及數理統計等進階課程奠定實作基礎，著重培養學生的「統計思維」與「資料分析能力」。因應科技趨勢，本學期首度將生成式 AI、Vibe Coding 與 AI 協作開發系統性導入教學。目標是引導學生從「學會寫程式」，升級為「能定義問題、拆解任務、運用 AI 協作並驗證除錯」的現代化數據人才。課程嚴格強調，AI 僅是需經驗證的助理，學生仍須具備獨立撰寫與閱讀程式的硬實力。本課程共 16 週，採階段式推進：期中前（扎根基礎）： 學習 R 語言基礎與統計概念實作。期中考採全程斷網、禁用 AI 的傳統上機考，確保學生具備獨立除錯能力。期中後（AI 協作與跨域）： 導入 Python、Git 版本控制，並深入學習 Claude Code 等前沿 AI 代理工作流。期末報告將透過模擬資料分析競賽，要求學生活用 AI Agent 解決真實數據問題。
course.objectives: 本課程目標在培養學生運用 R 語言完成資料輸入輸出、程式設計、統計圖形製作、資料處理，以及機率分布、中央極限定理、假設檢定與統計模擬等分析工作。同時也將教授 Python 的基礎程式設計、資料輸入輸出與統計繪圖，培養學生紮實的跨語言程式撰寫能力及基礎資料分析能力。除培養學生基本程式設計能力外，更強調問題定義、任務拆解、系統規劃與 AI 協作能力之養成。透過「先自己思考、再運用 AI 引導、最後進行自我監控」之三階段學習模式，引導學生建立後設認知能力與批判思考習慣，學習如何有效運用 AI 工具，同時驗證其產出結果之正確性與合理性。課程特別強調「把 AI 當學生，而非當老師」的理念，要求學生能向 AI 清楚說明統計概念、程式邏輯與分析決策，並透過持續提問、驗證與修正，深化對知識內容的理解。在學習成效方面，預期學生能熟悉 R、Python、RStudio、VS Code、GitHub 及生成式 AI 工具之基本應用，具備獨立撰寫程式、閱讀程式、除錯及資料分析之能力；同時能運用 AI 工具協助完成統計分析、資料視覺化及專案開發工作，並具備評估 AI 輸出品質、驗證分析結果及管理專案流程之能力。透過期中斷網上機考試與期末專題成果發表，學生將逐步由傳統「會寫程式」提升至「能定義問題、能驗證結果、能管理專案、能與 AI 協作」之能力層次，建立符合 AI 時代需求之統計思維、程式能力與資料科學素養，並為未來進修、研究及相關職涯發展奠定良好基礎。

course.description:
This is an introductory course that presents the most important methods for analyzing categorical data. This course will be devoted to categorical data analysis tools in various fields such as social science, public health and biomedical science. Topics include descriptive and inferential methods for contingency tables, generalized linear models, logistic regression models, Poisson regression, and/or loglinear model. R/SAS statistical software will be used throughout the course for data analysis.
Note that the "Course Schedule & Activity" are subject to change depending on the actual progress of the class.
Note #1：先備知識建議修過迴歸分析相關課程。
Note #2：每週教學內容、課程進度與活動，會依實際授課狀況做調整!
course.objectives: The course provides students the underlying foundations of categorical data analysis with applications. course.description:
A major component of the course involves mastering brand positioning—the art and science of differentiating a brand in a crowded market. Students will examine successful brand positioning strategies and learn how to craft strong, resonant brand identities that capture consumer attention and loyalty.
In addition to building brands, students will also learn to assess and measure brand equity, using key frameworks such as Keller’s Customer-Based Brand Equity (CBBE) model. Brand equity measurement will include understanding the strength of consumer-brand relationships, brand associations, and overall market performance. Through this, students will gain a comprehensive understanding of how brands maintain relevance and value over time.
The course is highly practical, with two core project components: brand audits and brand strategy development. In the brand audit project, students will choose a real-world brand to analyze, conducting a thorough review of its performance, market positioning, and consumer perception. The audit will serve as a foundation for the subsequent brand plan, where students will apply their insights to create a strategic and data-driven brand management plan.
Students will not only have a solid understanding of the theoretical aspects of brand management, but they will also be equipped with practical skills to develop and implement effective, long-term brand strategies. This combination of theory and practice will prepare students for future roles in marketing, brand management, or consulting, where strategic brand thinking is essential.
course.objectives: In this course, students will build upon the foundational knowledge acquired in their Marketing Management course, focusing on practical applications in product and brand management. The primary aim is to enhance students’ understanding of the consumer decision-making process and their ability to identify and interpret key customer insights. Students will explore the consumer decision-making process, brand positioning, brand equity measurement, and strategy development through brand audits and brand plans. By the end of the course, students will be able to develop a comprehensive, data-driven brand strategy.

course.description:
Occupational health psychology (OHP) is an interdisciplinary field of study that aims to improve the quality of work life and to promote the safety, health, and well-being of workers in all occupations. This course introduces fundamental theories and explores findings from cutting-edge research in industrial/organizational psychology, health psychology, and public/occupational health.
The objective of this course is to provide students with a thorough understanding of the various factors that affect workers’ physical and psychological health as well as safety and well-being (individual psychological attributes, job contents and work organization, organizational policies and practices, etc.) and to apply the knowledge to health safety, and well-being issues in the modern workplace.
This class is organized around the following themes: (1) an introduction to the foundations of occupational health psychology and Total Worker Health, (2) how the design and demands of jobs create health risks, (3) how social relationships and organizational contexts shape worker well-being, (4) how broader work systems and emerging forms of work influence occupational health, and (5) how organizations can design, evaluate, and justify evidence-based interventions to create healthier work.
This course takes a participatory approach. You will engage in a variety of learning activities, including lectures, hands-on activities, team/class discussions, case studies, and presentations. Each week, mini-lectures will highlight the conceptual foundations and practical implications of key theories and principles in occupational health psychology, rather than “covering” everything in the readings. Hands-on activities, team/class discussions, and case studies will help you apply important concepts from the readings and develop skills to analyze and manage problems that related to workers’ health, safety, and well-being in real-life settings. This foundational course is designed to demystify the inner workings of modern computing systems for first-year undergraduate students. Throughout the semester, we will embark on a comprehensive journey from the lowest levels of hardware abstraction to the high-level applications and systems that shape our digital world. Starting with the fundamental building blocks of how data is represented and processed at the circuit level, you will progressively build a rigorous understanding of computer architecture, operating systems, and networking.
Moving beyond theoretical concepts, this course heavily emphasizes hands-on, modern engineering practices. The curriculum is uniquely structured to bridge the gap between academic theory and real-world software development pipelines. As we advance, the course will also address the critical responsibilities that come with building and managing digital systems. We will explore the vital aspects of security, data integrity, and ethical intellectual ownership, culminating in an introduction to Artificial Intelligence. By the end of this course, you will possess both a strong theoretical foundation and the practical command-line and development toolkit necessary to succeed in your subsequent academic studies and future career.

course.description:
This course takes a distinctly practice-driven, problem-solving approach to teaching data science for business, one that departs significantly from traditional lecture-based instruction. Rather than presenting isolated techniques through static examples, the entire course is structured around collaboratively working through a real-world business dataset from end to end. Students engage with the same dataset across multiple phases, progressively building competencies in data preprocessing, transformation, analytics, visualization, and machine learning. This design mirrors how data science is actually practiced in industry.
A hallmark of this course is its emphasis on continuous, hands-on assessment. Ten in-class quizzes are administered throughout the semester, ensuring that students consistently code, apply, and internalize each technique before moving on. This high-frequency, low-stakes testing cycle, combined with a midterm exam, a final exam, and a capstone project, creates a rigorous feedback loop that reinforces both conceptual understanding and practical fluency.
The curriculum spans essential Python libraries for data science. The first stage focuses on Pandas for data preprocessing, transformation, time series handling, and analytics, followed by data visualization and NumPy for array-based computation. The second stage introduces Scikit-learn for machine learning, covering regression, classification, evaluation metrics, and model selection. By the end of the course, students will have developed an integrated, applied skill set to tackle business data challenges with confidence, rather than mere theoretical knowledge.
course.objectives:
Upon successful completion of this course, students will be able to:
Apply Python-based data science workflows to authentic business data, including data cleaning, preprocessing, transformation, and exploratory analysis using Pandas and NumPy.
Construct effective data visualizations that communicate business insights clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Implement and evaluate machine learning models, including regression and classification algorithms, using Scikit-learn, and select appropriate models based on rigorous evaluation metrics.
Demonstrate consistent hands-on coding proficiency, as evidenced by performance across 10 cumulative quizzes that assess applied problem-solving skills at each stage of the data science pipeline.
Synthesize end-to-end data science competencies in a capstone project, integrating data management, analytics, visualization, and machine learning to address a real-world business problem.
Adopt a problem-solving mindset that transfers beyond specific tools, approaching unfamiliar business data challenges with structured analytical thinking and practical Python skills.

This course will focus on financial theories and empirical evidence useful for investment decisions. In addition, this intends to provide the theoretical framework for further studies and work in the area.
The prerequisite course is
Investments
. Much of the material in this class is quantitative and highly analytical. Students should be comfortable with mathematical and statistics concepts.
course.objectives: The course covers risk and return, efficient market hypothesis, optimal portfolio choice, asset pricing models, investment strategies, and fund performance measurement. Students are exposed to a broad overview of modern finance and gain a deep understanding of certain key theories. Practical issues, such as data collecting, data manipulation, and data analysis, are also introduced. Students are expected to apply empirical techniques learned in class to actual stock price data and replicate selected results from the academic literature discussed in class.

course.description:
民法是私人之間法律關係的基礎法律規範，幾乎可以說，所有可能的私有財產或身分關係的法律糾紛，皆係運用「民法為基礎的法律規範」以達到「定紛止爭」的目的。生活在工商經濟活動甚為頻繁的現代社會裡，重要的民法基礎知識是維護生活利益不可或缺的常識，從生活用品的買賣、旅行契約的應有內容到借款投資的法律風險等等，如能瞭解法律、預先做好風險管理，必能預防糾紛，順利的實現生活或交易的目的。
基於前述的觀點，本課程之目標有下列三項：
(
一
)
瞭解一般人必備的法律知識
(
二
)
建立預防糾紛的風險管理觀念
(
三
)
培養專業經理人應有的民法基礎
course.objectives:
1.
是否了解民法相關之專有名詞的意義及規範目的
2.
能否熟悉民法各種行為制度的社會意義及規範功能
3.
能否理解民法相關權利義務與社會生活的關聯性，進而能體悟常見法律糾紛的發生因素與預防之道
4.
能否將法律規範的要件及法律效果，與社會生活中權利義務的取得與維護，有所連結

course.description:
本課程分為兩大部分。第一部分介紹人壽保險商品，包括各類保單型態、契約條款及相關保障內容，使學生了解人壽保險商品的設計與功能。第二部分探討壽險公司的經營與管理，包括核保、理賠、資金運用、風險管理及整體營運模式，以建立學生對人壽保險產業之完整認識。
This course is divided into two main parts. The first part introduces life insurance products, including major policy types, contractual provisions, and coverage features, providing students with an understanding of the design and functions of life insurance policies. The second part examines the operations and management of life insurance companies, including underwriting, claims management, investment activities, risk management, and business operations, enabling students to gain a comprehensive understanding of the life insurance industry.
course.objectives:
本課程目的為介紹人壽保險商品及壽險公司經營實務，使學生了解各類人壽保險商品之保障內容、契約條款及其功能，並建立對壽險產業運作模式的基本認識。修習本課程後，學生應能辨識主要人壽保險商品類型、了解保險契約之重要內容，以及掌握壽險公司在核保、理賠、資金運用與風險管理等方面之經營重點，進而培養未來從事保險相關工作所需之基礎專業知識與能力。
This course aims to provide students with a fundamental understanding of life insurance products and the operations of life insurance companies. By the end of the course, students should be able to identify the main types of life insurance products, understand the essential provisions and features of policies, and recognize the primary functions of life insurance companies, such as underwriting, claims management, investment activities, and risk management. The course also aims to provide students with the foundational knowledge and skills necessary for future careers in the insurance industry.

course.titleEn: Managing Pension Plan and Financing Retirement
course.description:
本課程介紹台灣長壽風險趨勢、退休金制度管理、退休的理財規劃與金融保險退休市場相關專業理論基礎與重要市場實務。本課程內容除了分析目前政府退休金制度與老人醫療長照制度外，更近一步了解台灣高齡化社會發展趨勢及長壽風險之影響，並說明金融市場相關商品與專業知識，藉以分析老人所需要的理財規劃與資金缺口，如何透過不同種類的退休投資型產品做出最是的資產配置以及理財規劃，最後再針對如何完整規劃個人退休理財與保障商品之實務，以個案分析方式，進行解說及實際試算操作。
為提升台灣退休理財專業人才之培訓，
本課程已獲准成為中華民國退休基金協會「退休理財規劃顧問(RFA)」認證課程之培訓課程，同學修完此課程後可取得RFA完成培訓之資格，可以直接報名參加「退休理財規劃顧問(RFA)」認證考試，通過考試即可取得RFA證照
。此外，通過RFA證照者也申請認列成為CFP®-M3課程（員工福利與退休金規劃課程）結業，學員僅需再參加其他模組課程後即可申請CFP®認證考試，進一歩取得CFP®認證資格。
course.objectives:
本課程培育同學對退休理財規劃的專業知識與能力，未來具備全方位的專業退休理財規劃的能力，可協助政府退休基金管理退休基金、協助金融機構行銷或設計退休商品，幫助企業雇主進行退休金規畫與教育，或協助消費者做好退休理財規劃。課程內容包括：
介紹我國長壽風險趨勢、退休金、高齡醫療與長期照護制度：退休金制度的三大支柱、退休金制度問題與年金改革影響、長照制度的發展與退休需求之未來發展。
分析擁有理想退休生活所需的財務準備與相關保障：分析退休後的財務需求、資金來源、缺口分析的條件假設及試算、彌補缺口的建議商品分析
分析金融市場相關退休理財商品與專業知識: 介紹非保險類產品與保險類投資商品
以個案方式解說如何進行個人退休理財最適規畫流程：透過了解自身風險程度、編製個人財務報表與預算、以個案分析方式，進行解說及實際試算操作

course.titleZh: ESG永續投資與綠色金融創新
course.titleEn: ESG Sustainable Investment and Financial Innovation
course.description:
近幾年全球受到疫情及極端氣候影響，世界經濟論壇(WEF)《全球風險報告》顯示環境氣候風險已成為全球必須嚴正面對的重要難題，因此ESG相關永續議題也成為全球重要發展趨勢。目前許多國家和企業皆愈來愈重視綠色金融與永續投資，而金融市場也不斷提出因應策略與創新商品協助企業及個人落實ESG政策。此外，全球主權基金、退休基金與金融機構也都紛紛簽署遵循責任投資原則(PRI)，將資金導入永續投資，許多企業也將ESG納入主要經營策略，積極進行數位永續轉型，使企業與環境都能邁向永續發展。
本課程為與證基會合作之學分班課程
，希望推廣大學院校學生對於永續金融之認識，以跨校、跨專長領域方式授課，透過理論與實務並重增加學生未來職場競爭力，期望能為台灣產業培育永續經營與綠色金融資產管理投資人才，
完成修課後將由證基會授予每位學員研習證明，
期末團體報告優勝組別，證基會將提供獎學金及獎狀以資鼓勵
。
課程內容主要介紹國內外ESG投資與綠色金融市場的發展趨勢，並
以國際CFA協會「ESG投資分析師證照(Certificate in ESG Investing)」考試之相關教材內容為基礎，
介紹永續金融重要的理論與實務運作，同時邀請國內跨校的永續研究領域知名教授授課，讓學生掌握當前市場最新ESG投資趨勢脈動，了解永續金融市場創新商品，並分享國內外典範公司落實永續投資成功實務經驗。
修習本課程的學生不僅能學習ESG投資的發展趨勢與知識，更可以了解如何報考國內「永續發展基礎能力測驗」，並規劃進階取得CFA 協會的ESG國際證照。

course.description: 在過去交通及科技較不發達時代，票據為商業活動過程中最常使用之付款工具，尤其在國內交易為甚，除企業經營者間之商業活動外，許多一般消費者之經濟活動，或民間之財務行為，如互助會合會、借款擔保、貨款給付或欠款償還等，亦多有以票據為付款之工具者，除此之外，票據基於其具有信用及流通之功能，以保護善意受讓該票據之第三人為大原則，基此乃產生與一般民法有所衝突不合之處，以票據法作為民法之特別法。再者，票據為使其具有一普遍接受之標準，法律乃將票據之種類予以明定，並限定其法定之方式及外觀，而使票據及其行為成為嚴格的法定要式行為，一有違背將使票據效力發生問題，亦因而使票據成為極為複雜之工具，本課程之目的即在使學生對於票據之種類、要件、轉讓方式及其效力、提示、追索等重要內容有所了解。但是近數十年來，科技、網路之發展，已經改變金錢流動的方式，網路匯款、電子支付，甚至其他種類之支付工具與方式持續發展，而虛擬貨幣之發展也改變支付內容，因此，傳統票據法所具有的功能受到很大的影響，但在我國商業與民間金流仍處處可見票據之使用，而法院訴訟事件涉及票具之事件每年仍超過五萬件，因此票據法仍屬於重要的商業法律。
course.objectives: 本課程旨在使學生了解票據分類、效力判斷、爭議問題之解決等，並避免學生因不知票據之效力而錯誤使用票據。

course.description:
國際經貿法此一學門包含公法與私法兩大領域，本課程將針對此兩大領域進行基本觀念的介紹，並以專題與個案研習的方式帶領及訓練同學分析有關國際經貿法實務運作下之重要議題。
就公法的領域（第一到十二週），台灣於2002年正式成為WTO的會員，因此，涉及WTO規範的我國相關法規，均必須遵守WTO的規定。WTO以貿易自由化為最核心之組織宗旨，涵蓋了包括貨品貿易、服務業貿易、智慧財產權等議題，針對該些議題均訂有會員必須遵守的基本法律原則，此外，WTO也提供一談判的場域，供會員協商、談判、修訂上述議題的管制內容，而涉及該些議題所引發之會員政府間的貿易爭端案件，也必須依照WTO下有關爭端解決之規範。故，本課程將主要以WTO法的範圍以及重要法律原則為主要的學習內容，搭配實際所發生之爭端案例，協助同學針對WTO法制與運作有基本的認識。
就私法的領域（第十三到十八週），主要課程內容乃在幫助同學瞭解國際商務中有關法規環境和運作規範，並培養管理法律風險的能力；特別是在面對國際企業經營過程中勢將遭逢法律衝突所衍生相關問題時，能具備分析問題、尋求解決方案的能力，俾使企業經營之風險及成本降至最低。
course.objectives:
International trade law covers both public law and private law. This course intends to give an overview to the most fundamental concepts of both these two legal dimensions through case studies.  For public law, the course will
introduce the fundamental international trade rules that are regulated under the World Trade Organization, including how these rules are applied and interpreted in the WTO dispute settlement cases. These international trade rules are crucial to Taiwan after Taiwan became a WTO Member in 2002. For private law, the course will give an overview to the legal environment and operational regulations concerning international business transaction, so that the students can be equipped with the ability to manage legal risks facing multinational enterprises.

course.description:
本課程之前身為開設給國貿系碩士班選修之「金融市場法規」，目前則與「
國際金融法專題（二）
」與「
國際經貿法
」並列為碩士班修課規定中四大領域之必群修科目；換言之，任選其一即可滿足法律領域之必群修要求。已滿足必群修要求者，本課程可認列為選修學分。
另一方面，由於本課程屬學、碩合開課程，故歡迎大三、四學生選修！凡對國際金融規範有興趣，想要嘗試研討型課程（
Seminar
）之大學部高年級生皆可選修，並無先修課程限制。事實上，本課程既為碩士班之必群修課程，故在設計上原已考慮到選修之碩士班學生來自不同之主修領域，並不特別要求需具備金融或法律之背景。不過鼓勵選修同學多關心國際金融市場時事，有助於增進對金融實務之了解，預習教材時會比較容易上手。
需特別說明的是本課程與
國際金融法專題（二）
各自擁有不同的獨立主題，不需同時選修，亦不需依序選修。換言之，兩者得僅選修其一。若是兩者皆選修，固然可以先修專題（一），但亦可先修專題（二）。總之，可根據自身修課計畫，自行決定兩者之修習順序。
本課程除了說明國際金融交易的定義以及現今國際監理架構外，將從三方面介紹國際金融市場之具體規範：第一部分為各國監理機構設計之比較、以及國際金融監理架構之起源；第二部分為國際金融市場之基礎設施準則，如：貨幣支付系統、審慎監理規則（前者將涵蓋加密貨幣與電子支付，後者則以巴塞爾規則為核心）；第三部分則介紹各種常見的國際融資／金融工具與相關的規範，包括國際聯貸、永續金融、店頭衍生性交易（如
SWAPs
）、專案融資、資產證券化、附買回交易等。

掌握巴塞爾資本適足要求規範之概念

course.description:
This course provides an overview of the strategic sales force management process, with particular emphasis on the formulation, implementation, and evaluation of sales programs. Rather than focusing on the interpersonal selling process or "how to sell," the course examines how organizations strategically design, lead, and manage salespeople, sales teams, and customer relationships in business-to-business (B2B) markets.
Topics include sales force recruitment, training, compensation, performance evaluation, motivation, leadership, territory management, and ethical decision-making. Through case discussions, managerial decision-making exercises, and simulations, students will develop the ability to think from the perspective of sales managers and organizational leaders. The course emphasizes both analytical decision-making and the human side of leading high-performing sales organizations.
This course incorporates the
Cantopia Sales Force Management Simulation
, an interactive platform that enables students to apply sales management concepts through experiential, team-based decision-making. Throughout the simulation, students will manage a virtual sales force and make strategic decisions regarding recruitment, compensation, territory allocation, workload management, and leadership.
course.objectives:
COURSE OBJECTIVES
The primary goal of this course is to examine the strategic role of sales force management as a critical component of an organization’s overall marketing effort. Emphasis is placed on how firms create customer value through effective sales leadership, relationship management, and sales strategy implementation. Specifically, this course aims to:
Introduce students to the evolving roles and responsibilities of contemporary salespeople and sales managers in today’s competitive business environment.
Develop students’ ability to make strategic sales management decisions using relevant business information, analytical frameworks, and managerial judgment.
Strengthen students’ ability to critically analyze and solve complex sales management challenges through evidence-based decision-making.
Enhance students’ communication, collaboration, leadership, and problem-solving skills through case discussions, applied learning activities, and managerial simulations.
Provide students with practical insights into professional selling and sales management careers while fostering ethical and customer-oriented leadership.
LEARNING OUTCOMES
By the end of this course, students will be able to:
Demonstrate foundational knowledge of sales management concepts, frameworks, and terminology.
Analyze sales management problems and develop strategic, evidence-based recommendations.
Evaluate sales force strategies, leadership decisions, and organizational performance using critical thinking and relevant business information.
Communicate sales management analyses and strategic recommendations effectively through professional written and oral presentations.
Apply appropriate technologies, business data, and performance metrics to support sales management decision-making.
Demonstrate ethical, global, and cultural awareness when evaluating sales management practices and organizational decisions.
Collaborate effectively in team settings to solve complex sales management problems.

course.description:

體系與組織為主──亦即是三大重要國際經濟組織：國際貨幣基金會（

course.titleEn: Independent Research on International Trade Policy(IV)
course.description:
This seminar is required for graduate students in the Department of International Business who specialize in International Economic and Trade Law. The seminar is offered under four course numbers—(I), (II), (III), and (IV)—which may be taken in any sequence. Completion of at least three seminar courses is required before a student may apply for the oral defense of the master's thesis.
Students are required to prepare essays and original research papers on current issues in international economic and trade law. All written work must meet professional academic and publication standards and be suitable for publication in the Trade Law E-Newsletter of the Research Center for International Organization and Trade Law.
course.objectives: The seminar aims to cultivate advanced research, analytical, and academic writing skills in the field of international economic and trade law. Through intensive research, writing, and discussion of contemporary legal and policy issues, students will develop the ability to critically evaluate emerging developments in the international trading system and to identify timely and significant topics for master's thesis research. The seminar is also designed to strengthen students' academic writing abilities and enhance the overall quality of their master's theses.

course.titleEn: Advanced Seminar on WTO Law: Trade in Services
course.description:
服務的產值逾全球國民生產毛額的三分之二，相關投資也幾乎達全球外人直接投資總額的三分之二。以貿易加值為核心的統計，更估計服務貿易占今日全球貿易比重近百分之五十。雖然其重要性與日俱增，但全球服務貿易多邊規範之發展直到
1986
年烏拉圭回合談判才展開。由於至今不過
40
餘年的歷史，相較於貨品貿易，無論是在自由化程度、規則之發展、或爭端案例之累積方面，仍有相當大的進步空間。
另一方面，其多邊規範建立之初固然是仿照貨品貿易規範，但由於服務之無形，以及服務提供者角色之重要，也使得服務貿易規範與貨品貿易規範有相當多不同之處。再加以服務貿易之主要障礙並非在邊境，而是在國內規章，不僅導致貿易統計資料不易蒐集，自由化之推動也因涉及各國之國內法規而相對困難。
了解上述問題、掌握規範之發展趨勢：包括雙邊、複邊與多邊場域已有之進展，並深入探討重要服務貿易領域，如金融服務貿易、電信服務貿易等規範之特殊性，即為本課程重點之一。另一方面，鑑於服務貿易以四種模式提供，故認識與服務貿易有關之投資、自然人移動、電子商務以及人工智慧等面向，則為本課程另一重點項目。
course.objectives:
Learning what the trade in services is.
Learning the structure of the General Agreement on Trade in Services
Learning the legal perspectives of service trade
Learning the negotiations of service trade
Understanding the future development of the service trade rules

course.department: 國貿碩一國貿博一國貿碩二國貿博二
course.description:
歐盟乃一不斷發展之動態統合過程，不同學說試圖解釋此一新興現象與演進背景。歐盟政經統合已發展至貨幣同盟階段，並推動共同外交暨安全政策、銀行聯盟、資本市場聯盟、能源聯盟、單一數位經濟市場並規劃財政聯盟等，形成最高整合層次的區域經貿整合組織，歐盟自稱為「超國家組織」。歐盟法律與政策皆是27個會員國利益相互激盪、競爭、辯證及調和之結果，代表歐洲集體智慧與創意巧思。歐盟乃WTO正式會員，並積極參與國際組織活動，據此，歐盟政策不但規範其所屬會員國，也深深影響國際規則發展動向，值得吾人共同關心，參考借鑑。
歐盟是以內部市場及
對外貿易
取得最大成就。本課程將介紹歐盟經貿專題，包括共同貿易政策、歐盟新一代FTA政策、貨幣政策、歐元、數位策略、人工智慧法(AIA)、數位服務法(DSA)、數位市場法(DMA)、防治假訊息、食品安全，COVID-19因應、俄烏戰爭因應、氣候變遷與能源安全、人權條款、歐盟對外關係、對等關稅與歐美關係、歐中關係、地緣政治變遷對歐盟的影響，以及台歐經貿關係等議題。這些議題皆是國際學術主流議題，頗具時效性及挑戰性。
本課程也將從事下列專題研究：
(1) 歐盟共同貿易政策：本課程共同貿易政策專題研究將討論：歐盟共同貿易政策、新一代FTA政策、國家安全與歐盟外資審查機制、歐盟晶片與半導體發展策略、歐盟與我國及中國大陸之經貿關係、中美競爭地緣政治對歐盟的影響等重要議題。
(2) 歐盟經貿法專題：歐盟碳邊境調整機制(CBAM)、ESG企業責任，以及俄烏戰爭對歐盟能源安全與歐俄能源貿易關係的影響等議題。
(3) 歐盟數位策略、AIA、DSA及DMA、數位歐元、防治假訊息專題。
course.objectives:
經濟區域整合已經是現今世界最重要的經濟貿易發展趨勢，歐盟自1950年代起，就開啟建構經濟整合的列車，逐步朝向深化及廣化方向發展。本課程提供一研究機會以從事歐盟經貿政策之法律、政治、經貿分析，以瞭解歐盟此一發展最為成功之超國家組織，WTO會員以及世界最大市場之特殊經貿暨銀行政策風貌。
在後冷戰時期，國際經濟已成為各國對外關係的主軸，以爭取本國最大利益及財富，並做為各國權力、地位及影響力之重要後盾。歐盟乃世界第一大經濟體，擁有近4.5億人口，對國際經貿規則的發展有重大影響力。歐盟也是台灣重要貿易伙伴、出口市場及外資及技術來源。本課程將討論歐盟一些重要經貿議題，包括：歐盟共同貿易政策、新一代FTA政策、歐元、氣候變遷與能源安全、CBAM、ESG企業責任、數位策略、晶片與半導體發展策略、人工智慧、數位貿易、俄烏戰爭對歐盟經貿政策的影響、台歐貿易關係等議題，以提升對歐盟經貿了解，培養具有歐洲觀及歐洲專業的高階人才，並提高歐洲學養及國際競爭力。

course.description:
Econometrics is a discipline grounded in advanced economic theories and various quantitative methods. It focuses on empirical tasks of analyzing observational data, such as estimating causal effects, testing economic theories, evaluating and implementing government and business policies, and forecasting key macroeconomic indicators.
Econometrics has become indispensable for economists conducting serious empirical research. This one-semester course is designed to introduce graduate-level students to well-established econometric tools, particularly regression-based methods for handling cross-sectional data.
The course will cover the following topics:
Multiple Regression Analysis: Estimation
Multiple Regression Analysis: Discussion
Multiple Regression Analysis: Inference
Multiple Regression Analysis: OLS asymptotics
Multiple Regression Analysis: Further issues
Multiple Regression Analysis with Qualitative Information
Heteroskedasticity
Instrumental Variables Estimation and Two Stage Least Squares
Limited Dependent Variable Models
Modern Econometrics and Causal Inference*
Instructional Method: Lecture
Course Requirements:
Students should have a solid understanding of undergraduate-level statistics, calculus, linear algebra, and economics before enrolling in the course. Regular attendance at lectures and completion of assigned exercises are required.
Please note that the course will begin with multiple regression analysis rather than simple regression analysis. Therefore, students who are not familiar with simple regression analysis (or the relevant statistical tools) are encouraged to review these concepts independently to ensure they can keep up with the course material.
course.objectives: By the end of the course, students will be equipped with the econometric and statistical techniques necessary for empirical analysis, which will be invaluable in their future careers, whether in industry or academia.

course.description:
This course covers the fundamental principles of investment, with an emphasis on theory and application. The first part of the course will give an overview of the financial market and discuss optimal portfolio choice under the modern portfolio theory. We will then discuss the equilibrium implications of optimal portfolio choice and derive the capital asset pricing model (CAPM). Next, we will look into the arbitrage pricing theory (APT) and factor investing. The last part will cover other asset classes, performance evaluations, and risk management.
We will extensively use Python to analyze financial data and backtest portfolio strategies.  There are no prerequisites for the course, but students are expected to have a strong background in statistics and calculus.
This is a
distance-learning (遠距課程)
course. We will only meet in the classroom for Week 1 (Course Overview).
course.objectives:
1. To understand the fundamental theories of portfolio choice and asset pricing.
2. To understand and apply portfolio management techniques.
3. To understand the investment framework and conduct performance evaluation and risk management.
4. To acquire practical experience in working with financial data.
5. To develop skills in reading academic and practitioner journals.
6. To gain insights about trends in investment and portfolio management.

債券商品（股價指數連動債券、高收益債券、信用連結債券等）

保險商品（投資型保單、巨災債券等）
·
加密資產（比特幣、以太幣、穩定幣等）

實體資產代幣化（Real-World Assets, RWA）（股票代幣化、債券代幣化、不動產代幣化等）
修習本課程後，學生應能：
了解金融創新商品之發展背景、設計理念及市場功能。
熟悉各類金融創新商品之產品架構、交易機制、定價原理、報酬來源及風險特性。
了解金融創新商品之定價概念、避險機制及風險管理方法，並能分析其投資價值及適用情境。
能閱讀並分析金融商品說明書及主要契約條款，理解商品設計邏輯、投資風險及相關法規要求。
能運用金融理論分析金融創新商品之風險與報酬特性，培養獨立分析及解決問題之能力。
了解銀行、券商、投信及保險公司等金融機構於金融創新商品之設計、發行、交易及風險管理之實務運作。
認識金融市場最新發展趨勢，包括主動式 ETF、加密資產、穩定幣及實體資產代幣化（Real-World Assets, RWA）等新興金融商品。
透過實際案例分析、金融業界專家演講及參訪證券商、投信公司與銀行等金融機構，了解金融創新商品之實務運作，培養整合理論與實務、分析問題及獨立思考之能力。

course.description:
在現代經濟體系中，金融機構不僅是推動經濟發展的血脈，更是承受總體環境波動的前線。面對地緣政治風險、全球利率週期更迭、日趨嚴格的國際監管規範（如
Basel IV
、
IFRS 17/ICS

AI

GenAI

:
宏觀監管與合規韌性：

直面
FinTech
與生成式
AI
對傳統金融的衝擊，研究金融機構如何利用科技進行數據變現、流程自動化、反詐欺防禦，並重新定義全通路客戶體驗。

course.titleEn: ESG/Sustainable finance: Responsible Investing, Green Financing and Green Insurance
course.description:
Sustainable finance has become inextricably integrated into the capital markets in order to support economic growth and reduce environment problem. The financial system is integral to achieving a smooth transition to a low carbon economy. Sustainable innovation is a process where sustainability considerations (environmental, social, financial) are integrated into company systems from idea generation through to research and development and commercialization. The course is designed to help the students gain an understanding of the sustainability development goals (SDGs), initiatives and regulations that support to develop the sustainable financial systems. This applies to products, services and technologies, as well as new business and organization model that are able to embed environmental, social and governance considerations. In addition, sustainable finance includes a strong green finance and climate finance components that aim to support economic growth while reducing pressures on the environment, addressing green-house gas emissions and tackling pollution, minimizing waste and improving efficiency in the use of natural resources. Therefore, we will also cover the full scope of sustainable finance providing an integrated view on investing, banking, and insurance
To absorb the knowledge and the experience of sustainable development from the leading financial institution, we will also invite their sustainable research teams to give lectures and mentoring the students in this course. They will cover and be arranged in the following fields:
1, 本課程將邀請業師參與授課
2, 本課程有期末專題發表補助
3, 本課程有永續金融證照補助
course.objectives:
The objective of this course is to integrate theory and application through the use of relevant case studies, reports and research papers. Students will become familiar with the main policies, regulations, frameworks, market initiatives, financial products and service to develop sustainable finance especially in green action today. The course will also explore the major obstacles and the opportunities facing the investors and financial institutions.
After taking this course, the student can develop their financial and problem-solving skills. In addition, the students shall have better management knowledge, global perspective, sustainable development and communication skill in ESG/SDG issues associated with financial markets

course.description: This research-oriented course is designed to help students gain an in-depth understanding of quantitative investments. We will start by discussing risk factors for equities and FICC (fixed income, commodities, and currencies), and by learning about the econometric test of factor efficiency. For the next topic, we will study the statistical estimation of factors with regularization. Finally, the course will cover various portfolio construction methods and discuss their efficacy in outperforming the simple naïve portfolio weighting scheme. The prerequisites for this course are basic knowledge in investment science (mean-variance portfolio, arbitrage portfolio theory, Fama-French factor portfolio) and statistical learning (eigenvalue decomposition, L1/L2 regularization).
course.objectives:
Evaluate key pricing anomalies and risk premia across diverse asset classes.
Apply sophisticated econometric techniques to estimate asset-pricing factors.
Construct and evaluate advanced portfolio strategies.
Synthesize academic findings with real-world insights from quantitative practitioners to assess the implementation challenges and viability of quantitative investment strategies.

本課程將請資誠會計師事務所協助，提供同學國際租稅與家族傳承等實務案例進行個案研究，部分上課將到資誠會計師事務所，由會計師與經理團隊指導分組同學學習，教學大綱課程安排及進度將配合調整，請以第一次上課提供之課程大綱版本為準。
本課程歡迎非稅務以及非會計背景學生修習，課程學習著重稅務觀念及實務應用能力之建立，而非技術性之稅務知識教學。
租稅是為現今國家及企業最重視的課題之一，因應目前全球進行中之國際租稅改革、
GRI
報告、
ESG
倡議等，企業須提高其租稅資訊透明度，並整合於其移轉訂價報告及永續報告書中揭露。企業亟需建構完善租稅處理能力，有效管理稅務風險，具備高階稅務能力的會計人，是目前國內外大型企業迫切需要的專業人才。本課程旨在培育高階稅務專業人才，課程設計包括透過稅務案例與稅務實務探討建構同學稅務思考能力、以及透過探討有效租稅規劃觀念性架構、各稅法實務問題等提升同學應用稅法之能力。
設計之課程內容包括三部分：
1.
稅務案例實務問題探討。
(
小組報告
)
2.
租稅規劃觀念性架構、我國各稅法稅務議題探討。
(
上課及討論
)
3.
分組個案研究報告。
(
分組報告
)
course.objectives:
本課程的精神是學生參與方式教學，課程的核心是同學參與小組討論與上課與老師及同學間互動研討，課程設計目的包括：
1.
以案例情境討論方式幫助同學掌握稅法之觀點。
2.
培養同學團隊合作及參與討論個案的精神，提升稅法運用及表達能力。
3.
培養學生對租稅規劃綜合思考之能力，包括租稅與非租稅成本之規劃。
4.
以參與式討論個案培養學生解決實際租稅規劃問題之能力。
5.
透過會計師事務所指導之實務個案研究報告，培養學生掌握及應用興新稅務問題之能力。

course.description:
This course provides an introduction to programming fundamentals and widely used econometric methods using Python—a powerful, open-source language for scientific data analysis. The primary focus is on developing students’ logical reasoning and analytical thinking skills, rather than on programming alone. Hands-on coding exercises during class sessions will help students enhance their logical ability and become familiar with programming.
The course begins with a basic introduction to Python, including installation and essential functions and methods. It then moves on to data management and analysis using NumPy, Pandas, and Seaborn.
course.objectives: Coding practice is designed to strengthen students’ logical reasoning and analytical thinking. In addition, students will learn fundamental econometric and statistical techniques for data analysis—skills that are highly valuable for future careers in both industry and academic research.

course.description:
透過介紹各產業之運作，讓學生瞭解各產業之營運模式、上中下游合作模式及其特殊之會計、審計及風險；除可加強自身之產業知識外，並可藉此培養自身蒐集/彙總資料的能力及個人 口條/台風的訓練，以增加自己的價值。

course.description:
【加簽說明】
欲申請加簽本課程之學生，應於第一堂課親自出席；未出席第一堂課者，原則上不受理加簽。
本課程受限於教室容量及可容納人數。若申請加簽人數超過可加簽名額，將依下列順序辦理：
本系碩士班二年級學生。
本系碩士班一年級學生。
受限於教室容量
(這間教室
總共只能坐
50
人
)
，加簽順位目前設定為高年級優先，其次是低年級
(
抽籤
)
。
符合上述資格並不代表一定能獲得加簽，最終仍須視教室容量、實際修課人數及課程教學安排而定。
【課程簡介】
本課程旨在為會計研究領域之研究生提供一套實證研究常用之方法工具箱（
toolbox of empirical methods
），協助學生提前模擬碩士論文的實證過程。
課程將聚焦於財務會計
(or
審計研究
)
中的研究設計問題，並透過實際資料、代表性研究文獻及
Stata
操作，介紹會計實證研究中常見的統計方法。
本課程屬於應用導向之實證研究訓練課程，而非以數學證明及計量理論推導為主之理論計量經濟學課程。課程不要求學生進行繁複的數學推導，但學生仍須理解各項實證方法的基本概念、識別邏輯、主要假設、適用條件及可能限制。
本課程將以
Stata
為主要分析工具，透過循序漸進的資料處理、程式操作、論文閱讀及研究設計練習，使學生逐步具備在適當研究指導下，執行基礎至中階會計實證研究的能力。
課程預計涵蓋下列主要研究方法與實證設計：
橫斷面資料（
cross-sectional data
）與縱橫資料（
panel data
）之基本實證分析。
固定效果模型（
fixed effects models
）及相關估計策略。
具代表性實證研究之重現（
replication
）。
其餘選擇性議題：
選擇偏誤（
selection bias
）與內生性（
endogeneity
）問題之辨認、診斷及基本處理方式。
工具變數法（
instrumental variables, IV
）。
差異中之差異法（
difference-in-differences, DiD
）。
事件研究法（
event study
）。
匹配法（
matching methods
）。
實際授課內容與方法深度，將視課程進度及學生整體學習狀況適度調整。
除統計方法及軟體操作外，本課程亦重視研究設計之判斷能力。學生應逐步學習如何評讀會計研究文獻，並針對研究問題、理論動機、識別策略、樣本選擇、變數衡量、資料處理及推論有效性提出具體且有依據的分析與評論。
學生亦將透過數個循序漸進的小型研究專題
or
小型作業，練習完成下列實證研究流程：
形成具體且可檢驗之研究問題。
建立研究假說與研究設計。
蒐集、整理及合併研究資料。
建構及檢驗主要研究變數。
執行統計分析及穩健性檢驗。
製作符合學術研究慣例之表格。
解讀實證結果並撰寫研究結論。
辨認研究限制及可能之替代解釋。
【適合修課對象】
本課程適合下列學生修習：
規劃以實證研究方法完成碩士論文之研究生。
對實證財務會計研究（
empirical financial accounting research
）或實證審計研究（
empirical auditing research
）有興趣之學生。
希望建立會計研究資料處理、
Stata
操作及實證論文解讀能力之學生。
其他

course.objectives:
一、課程目標（
Course Objectives
）
本課程將聚焦於實證財務會計研究中的研究設計問題，涵蓋資料整理、變數建構、迴歸分析、縱橫資料分析及常見之研究設計。課程以
Stata
軟體為主要資料處理與統計分析工具，強調實際操作、方法選擇、識別假設及研究限制之整合判斷，而非著重於複雜數學推導。
透過代表性文獻閱讀、程式演練、研究設計分析及小型實證專題，學生將逐步培養下列能力：
理解實證財務會計研究中常見方法的基本概念與識別邏輯。
使用
Stata
完成資料整理、變數建構、統計分析及結果輸出。
辨識研究設計中的選擇偏誤、內生性及其他推論威脅。
評估實證方法的適用條件、識別假設與研究限制。
整合研究問題、資料、方法及實證結果，完成初步實證研究報告。

Learning Outcomes
）

程式作業、課堂實作、小組演練

辨識實證研究中的選擇偏誤、遺漏變數、反向因果關係及其他內生性來源，並比較可能之研究設計或處理策略。

研究設計作業、期中報告、課堂討論

整合研究問題、文獻、資料、變數、實證方法與結果解釋，撰寫具基本研究結構之實證研究報告。
創造（

LO6
解讀統計估計結果，區分統計顯著性、經濟顯著性與因果解釋，並辨認合理之替代解釋。
分析與評估（
Analyze and Evaluate
）
程式作業、實證結果解讀、期中及期末報告
三、學習成果與課程定位之補充說明
本課程所稱之「因果推論」與「因果識別」，並不表示僅透過特定統計方法即可自動建立因果關係。學生應理解，因果推論之可信度主要取決於研究設計、制度背景、資料品質及識別假設，而非僅取決於統計模型或軟體指令。
因此，本課程除要求學生具備
Stata
操作能力外，亦要求學生能回答下列問題：
資料與變數是否足以衡量所欲研究之經濟概念？
實證結果是否可能受到其他機制或替代解釋影響？
統計顯著之結果是否同時具有經濟意義？
本課程之目標，不僅是使學生能執行統計程式，更在於使學生能判斷實證結果是否具有可解釋性及研究價值。

This is an introductory course that presents the most important methods for analyzing categorical data. This course will be devoted to categorical data analysis tools in various fields such as social science, public health and biomedical science. Topics include descriptive and inferential methods for contingency tables, generalized linear models, logistic regression models, Poisson regression, and/or loglinear model. R/SAS statistical software will be used throughout the course for data analysis.

course.description: Reliability Analysis is one of the core areas of industrial statistics. Students will learn to apply these techniques using the software R, performing comprehensive data analysis on real data presented in the textbook.

However, please note that in the second half of the course, hand calculations and derivations will be required. Make sure you have a good understanding of calculus  and matrix operations before taking this course.

course.description:
本課程由兩大模組組成：第一模組為事業創新策略，由鄭至甫老師教授；第二模組為智慧財產管理策略，由馮震宇老師教授。
第一模組：事業創新策略 (授課老師：鄭至甫)
本模組旨在培育學理與實務兼備的研究者。在高度的環境不確定下，企業與競爭者及眾多利害關係人的關係也不斷在進化，唯有具備策略思維與創新思維的經營者，才能與時俱進地應對動態環境。本模組將以個案討論及頂尖實務研究文獻為基礎，學員將共同討論事業創新觀念與架構，並探討實務與學術理論之連結，以建構學員實務應用與學術研究之能力。
第二模組：智慧財產管理策略 (授課老師：馮震宇)
有鑑於智慧財產權已經成為當下各國企業競爭的核心能力與資產，在全球競爭日益加劇的趨勢下，擁有與掌控智慧財產權成為各國企業成長與茁壯的關鍵。此外，隨著科技的快速發展與AI時代的到來，智慧財產權更成為企業能否順利進入市場與排除他人競爭的關鍵。是故，如何在策略上透過創新進而掌握智慧財產權、並將智慧財產權應用於企業經營乃成為企業競爭的關鍵因素之一。本課程將著重於從管理與策略的層面探討企業所面臨的創新與智慧財產權問題，並嘗試將創新與智慧財產權帶入企業策略架構，使企業能在事業創新以及智慧財產權的創造、保護、管理與利用的四個階段中，結合管理、策略與智財，為企業創造最大的價值。
course.objectives:
第一模組：事業創新策略
本模組目標包含：
學習事業創新實務於國際最新應用
強化事業創新實務與理論連結
培養策略思維與創新思維
培養結合實務與理論之研究能力
審視台灣企業瓶頸，以臻永續發展
第二模組：智慧財產管理策略
主要目標在於探討事業創新與智財策略，並期透過智慧財產權觀念的介紹與個案的討論，引領同學能對創新與智慧財產權之關係，從認識進而掌握，最後透過智財策略加以應用，以強化企業競爭能力與增加企業整體價值，以達成value-up的目標。本課程中除介紹智財趨勢與現況外，主要將透過個案討論方式，幫助同學了解企業如何運用創新與智財管理與策略手段達成企業管理與策略目標，並將智財與管理及策略結合，使企業能將智財運用於企業的實際營運，並進而創造企業價值。

course.description: Research methods are often taught as standalone subjects, as if they were ends in themselves. This course takes a different approach. In qualitative research, methods cannot be separated from the theoretical puzzles and phenomena they are used to study. Methods are not fixed toolkits, but sets of practices that must be selected, adapted, justified, and, at times, invented in relation to specific research questions and contexts. In this course, students will learn not only how to use qualitative methods, but also how to think methodologically: how to make research design decisions, examine the assumptions behind those decisions, develop studies that are responsive to the puzzles and phenomena they seek to understand, and make knowledge claims supported by evidence. The central premise of the course is that methods should serve the topic of inquiry, rather than forcing the topic to fit the method.
course.objectives:
Developing the knowledge to understand the essence and different paradigms in the world of qualitative research
Developing the ability to evaluate the quality of qualitative research works
Developing the skills to design and conduct qualitative research

course.description:
The primary objective of the course is to review some important theoretical perspectives (theories) in the industrial organizational economics literature. The course is structured to allow students to develop research questions and students are expected to submit one academic paper at the end of this course.
Class participation:
The course is set up with a 3-hour lecture each week on Tuesday. Students are expected to prepare referee reports (in PowerPoint format) each week, and each person will be required to present the assigned paper each week. Moreover, one assigned person will be responsible for leading the discussion (including session opening, summarizing the whole papers, and preparing the hardcopy of handouts).
When reading papers and preparing for your weekly referee reports, students are encouraged to pay attention to the following questions:
What is the key research question?
Why is this research question interesting and important? What’s the gap identified?
Are these hypotheses (or propositions) convincing and well-developed?
Are the context and research designs appropriate for testing these hypotheses?
What are the main findings? Are there any alternative explanations for these findings?
•  What limitations does this research have? How can you apply these findings in your term paper or even your own research?
Readings:
Each week we will cover a set of topics that are important in the industrial organizational economics theory literature. You will need to read and understand the following papers to participate in class.
Term paper:
For the term paper, students are expected to conduct a literature review for a theory and develop propositions or testable hypotheses.
course.objectives:
Knowledge Objectives
Understand various theoretical perspectives underlying organizational theory research.
Understand the research questions, key assumptions, theoretical development, critical findings, and limitations of published papers in organizational theory.
Skill Objectives
Ability to evaluate, interpret, and provide developmental comments for theoretical and empirical research in organizational theory papers.
Ability to formulate meaningful or even interesting research questions, develop testable hypotheses or propositions, and conduct appropriate research designs.

course.description:
As the scope of technology continues to broaden in organizations, the management of information technology (IT) and information systems (IS) becomes both more challenging and more critical. This course will provide students with a deep understanding of the theories and issues surrounding the information systems management. This is one of the main research streams in the IS field and it has received significant research attention in the last 20 years.
This course covers the strategic information management and investigates the potential use of IT/IS to improve organizational competitive advantage. Students are exposed to topics such as business value of IT/IS, IT/IS adoption and diffusion, e-commerce, management of global supply chains, and so on. The articles are mainly drawn from the top IS journals such as MIS Quarterly, Information Systems Research, Journal of Management Information Systems, and International Journal of Electronic Commerce. The focus is on providing an in-depth coverage of key issues related to the strategic management of IS/IT.
