course.description:
This course is the continuation of the Polish I course. It ensures a solid command of the grammatical structures in a practical communicative context. Students develop four
key language skills – listening, reading, speaking and writing – based not only on textbooks but also on authentic materials (e.g. announcements, commercials, excerpts from TV programs, surveys, songs). The contents of the course include subjects related
to everyday life situations. The aim of the course is to enable students to communicate in Polish on a variety of practical everyday matters, taking them from level A1 towards level A1+/A2 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR).
course.objectives:
By the end of the course students will be able to:
- understand sentences and frequently used expressions related to areas of most immediate relevance (e.g. very basic personal and family information, shopping, local geography, employment)
- communicate in simple and routine tasks requiring a simple and direct exchange of information on familiar and routine matters
- describe in simple terms aspects of their background, immediate environment and matters in areas of immediate need.

course.description:
本課程は、「恋愛はなぜ文学の主題となるのか」という問題について考えることを目指す授業です。日本文学の歴史を辿れば、古典文学から現代の漫画・アニメ・ドラマ・映画に至るまで「恋愛」は、主要なテーマであり続けてきました。そしえ、それらを注意深く観察すると、そこに一定のパターン（法則）があることが確認されます。
授業の前半では、まず物語論の基礎について学びます。物語論とは、文学作品を論じる方法論として代表的なものの一つですが、まずは物語論の前提となった言語理論や構造主義の考え方について学び、それを踏まえた上で、物語論の基礎となる用語や枠組みについて学んでいきます。そして、後半では、主に、宮野真生子『なぜ、私たちは恋をして生きるのかー「出会い」と「恋愛」の近代日本精神史ー』（ナカニシヤ出版、
2014
年）を土台として、近代日本において「恋愛」とは何であったのかを考えていきます。
受講レベル目安：日本語能力試験N1又はそれに準ずる日本語能力
course.objectives:
以下の能力の養成を目的とします。
物語論の基礎について理解できるようになる
「日本文学」の歴史的展開と構造が理解できるようになる
自らの視点が既に「何か」（近代性）によって制御‐編集されていることに気づき、世界や自己自身に対する認識を相対化できるようになる

course.description:
本課程
探究第二次世界大戰結束之後，現代日本社會的諸多問題及其面向，同時兼論此面向與當時政治情況的關聯性。本課程
主要由以下三個大主題構成。
一為
「戰後」的總清算及其走向。亦即，
從
「終戰紀念日」的創出、歷史教科書問題，
探究日本如何看待戰爭責任問題，如何進行
「戰後」的總清算及其目前的狀況
；另外，日本如何定位在位期間
（
1926-1989
年
）
跨及戰爭時代、戰後廢墟與高度經濟成長的昭和天皇，也是不容忽視的課題
。
二為高度經濟成長期至
1990
年代初期
泡沫經濟崩潰後「失落十年」或「失落二十年」之日本社會問題，又細分為日本式經營下的勞動型態與其在失落時代的轉變、區域發展不均（以日本海沿岸地區與日本東北為例）
。
三為日本社會中弱勢族群的「差別」（歧視）問題，又以女性與家、「部落民」、「在日」（在日
Korean
）
、沖繩人與美軍基地、愛努民族為探究對象。
※語言程度要求最好有日語檢定一級以上。
course.objectives:
1
、
透過上述的主題設計，期讓學生從政治與社會層面的相互關聯性，來加深對日本現代社會的理解；同時，由於臺灣與日本在歷史上、社會經濟層面上關係非常密切，不少的現象都有雷同或相關之處，因此課堂討論也將著重臺日比較的觀點，讓學生從「他者」藉此反思「自己」。
2
、期許學生超越語言學習的層級，進一步從日語這個「工具」，深入認識中文世界沒有剖析到的日本。
3
、上課方式重視學生自主性與討論，基本上，每週上課方式分成兩個部分。第一個部分是學生的課堂分組口頭發表，由負責發表的學生根據每週的課堂主題，事前構思發表的架構，蒐集、消化相關資料，然後在課堂上進行約
20
分鐘的發表，同時設定至少兩題的問題供師生討論。第二部分是本人針對學生的發表進行回饋，並配合圖表及照片等輔助資料加以補充，帶引全班進行當週主題的最終討論。透過此方式，期許學生更深入、更自主地思考現代日本社會之諸多現象。

course.description:

course.objectives:

(二)基於上述之課程目標，本課程主要內容可分以下四部份:
（1）日本上代至中古時代文學概論。

course.titleZh: 日本名著選讀Ｃ１：歷史文化
course.titleEn: Selected Readings in Japanese Literature C1 : History and Culture
course.description:
日本戰後著名的思想家﹑大眾文化評論家之一的鶴見俊輔，1980年代受邀至加拿大講學，因而留下了兩本具代表性的著作：《戰爭時期日本精神史1931-1945年》﹑《戰後日本大眾文化史1945年-1980年》。本課程將以此2本著作為主要閱讀文本，了解鶴見所提出的重要概念ー「轉向」，進一步探討國族主義及國家權力對日本近現代社會的影響。例如：日本的「鎖國思想」及「國體概念」如何形成﹑二戰前日本左派知識份子如何主動/被動地「轉向」成為軍國主義的推手；而戰後的美日關係及經濟成長背後如何殘存著「轉向」的影子，以及日本的漫畫﹑電視﹑漫才﹑流行音樂等大眾媒介，又是如何扮演著與「轉向」對立或支持者的角色。透過直言不諱卻不失幽默感的「鶴見式口吻」，與其博聞強識下的豐富例子，每個篇章都能幫助我們
跳脫歷史教科書的框架，
更全面性地理解近代日本社會與大眾文化的特徵與發展歷程。
本課程仿讀書會形式，將先由教師導讀1-5章，而後由同學分組輪流負責各週指定章節的摘要簡報，並於課堂進行問題與討論。期中亦將舉行筆試，期末則須繳交繳交2000字相關主題之個人期末報告。
◎
注意：
1. 本課程主要以中文授課/討論，但指定文獻﹑PPT簡報均以日文呈現，故選課對象僅限
JLPT N2程度以上(含N2)
的
同學。
2. 第1週將進行詳細課程介紹並開放分組，請選修的同學
務必出席第1週之課程
，無法出席者請來信請假。
3. 授課模式﹑指定文本章節之選定及排序等，都將視班級學習狀況與校方政策隨時修正調整。
course.objectives:
透過文獻讀解，深化對於日本政治思想及國家體制的認識。
跳脫既有歷史教科書中的框架，以更為多元﹑包容的歷史/文化價值觀重新審視日本與台灣﹑亞洲的相互關係。
透過分組文獻摘要簡報與課堂討論，訓練資料統整及批判思考能力。

course.description:
本課程は、日本語中級～上級レベルの会話トレーニングのための授業です。
指定されたコンテクストの議論に参加し、自分の意見を正確に表現できるような訓練を行っていきます。具体的には、「ケース・メソッド」
（
case method
）、
「スピーチ・プレゼン＆ディスカッション」という２つの内容によって授業を構成します。第一の「ケース・メソッド」とは、実際の生活の中で起こりうるトラブルやコンフリクトを事例として取り上げ、ディスカッションを通じて問題の把握と解決法について学んでいくものです。今回は、日本に留学中の学生が大学生活やアルバイトで体験したトラブルの事例や、日系企業に就職した外国人が職場で経験したトラブルの事例などをもとにディスカッションを行います。そして、第二の「スピーチ＆ディスカッション」では、まず指定されたテーマについて、毎回２人が５分ずつスピーチ・プレゼンを行います。そして、その後で、その内容を踏まえて全員でディスカッションを行います。
なお、日本語のレベルは、日本語能力試験N2以上であることを基準とします。授業は全て日本語で行います。
（ただし、本課程は日本語非母語話者を対象としたものであるので、日本語母語話者の受講は認めません）
また、
113
学年度以前に「日語主題討論與簡報訓練１」の授業を履修した人は、本課程を受講できませんので注意してください。
course.objectives:
以下の能力の開発を目的とします。
日本語を用いて、流暢かつ自然に母語話者とやりとりを行なうことができるようになること。
日本語を用いて、身近なコンテクストの議論に参加し、さまざまな選択肢について長所や短所を示しながら、自分の意見を適切に述べることができるようになること。
日本のビジネス習慣や、日本社会の「暗黙のルール」を理解すること。

course.description:
本課程以強化
日語口說及字詞運用能力為主要目的，並
分為2大主軸：
①以各類現代日本日常生活中的情境對話﹑廣播等為文本，展開「朗讀」﹑「跟述」等基礎訓練。亦將搭配動畫或日劇作品的片段，讓同學們透過反覆模仿及口說練習，自然地熟悉日語聲調﹑掌握各種情緒的聲音表情。
②嘗試以日本J-POP歌曲為例，分析歌詞中特有的品詞﹑語法表現與語彙運用特徵，強化
對日本的「語言-情感結構」之理解與表達溝通能力。帶領同學用日語進行歌詞或介紹校園之文字創作。
期末讓大家以聲音﹑影像或文字等綜合形式來創作一部小組作品。
本課程每單元均使用教師自編教材，自行練習各週指定作業，於隔週上課時進行口頭驗收。並於期中期末各舉行1次課堂筆試，期末則舉辦1~3人的小組創作發表會。
*選課注意事項：
1.
本課程主要目的是讓日語學習者透過反覆練習，熟悉自然的日語語調，接觸更多元的「日語表現」，激發用日語創作的靈感。因此課堂中將不會進行詳細的文法說明或句型練習，敬請理解。

course.titleZh: 日本研究入門：議題與方法
course.titleEn: Introduction to Japan studies: Issues and Methods
course.description:
本課程は、将来、日本への留学や大学院への進学を検討している人を対象とし、日本研究の基礎知識と技術を身につけることを目的とした授業です。
大学で「日本」について「専門的に」学ぶ場合、通常、日本語学習から始まるのが基本となりますが、一方で、そのまま「日本」に関わる諸「学問」の場へと移行することなく卒業してしまうケースも決して珍しいとは言えない状況にあります。そのため、いざ大学院へ進学したり日本へ留学したりしても、そこでも日本語学習の延長しかイメージできず、「思っていたのと違った」と挫折を余儀なくされるケースも少なくないように思われます。本課程は、そのような現状を打破するために設置されたものです。
授業の前半では、そもそも「研究」とは何かという問題から始め、研究テーマの設定の仕方、文献の収集・調査方法を学びます。あわせて、レポートや論文の書き方、口頭発表の仕方という実際的なテクニックについても実例を踏まえながら学んでいきます。後半では、人文系学問分野で広く参照されている理論の幾つかを学びます。最終的には、受講生が各自の研究テーマを選定し、研究計画書を作成してもらいますが、それによって、将来の日本留学や大学院進学の準備の助けになればと考えています。
course.objectives:
本課程は、以下の能力の養成を目的とします。
自分の視点が既に「何か」によって制御‐編集されていることに気づくこと
研究計画書を適切に作成できること
引用・注釈などのレポート・論文作成上のルールを正しく身につけられるようになること

course.description:
【公告】給希望加簽「日本社會與文化」課程的同學：
謝謝大家的支持，希望選修此門課程的同學十分踴躍，因此今年也將會另開5~7個加簽名額
為了公平起見，均統一在第1堂課以隨機抽籤的方式決定加簽資格
歡迎有興趣的同學前來聆聽9/8(二)的課程簡介與評量說明，現場參加抽籤。
無須再個別寄email給金老師詢問加簽事宜囉！感謝同學們的配合！
本課程首先從影響近代日本甚鉅的「西洋文化元素」，包括「飲食文化」﹑「外來節慶」﹑「戰後美國強勢文化」等特定主題切入，探討明治時期起，至戰後2000年代的日本對外關係及國內政治經濟之狀況，是如何對社會文化，乃至於民眾的日常生活，產生關鍵性的影響，社會文化又是如何反映日本政治經濟的特徵。並同時關注與台灣之間的連結，讓同學更深入理解台灣於戰前戰後受到日本文化影響的背景與脈絡。
另一主題則從「人的移動」來觀察「外人(外籍者)」在日本的生活情況，亦回顧時常被遺忘的「台日移民」交流史，進一步理解所謂「外來族群」在日本社會中的特殊位置和認同糾葛，思考日本社會之現狀與面臨之問題。
主要以教師自製教材與相關影片進行講授，學期中將需繳交數次課堂回饋單。期中個人作業為繳交指定作品觀後心得，期末則會以分組報告的形式，自行選定相關主題之特定作品或文化現象進行分析。
※選修注意事項
1.本課程主要以中文進行授課﹑討論，但因需搭配多種日文文本，雖不影響成績，但可能多少會減低上課時的理解度或趣味性，較建議本系生﹑日文系雙修/輔系生，或者JLPT N4程度以上的同學選修。
2.因歷年來希望選修此門課程的同學都十分踴躍，故每學期均會開放數個加簽名額(不分系所)，原則上在開學第1堂課公開抽籤。歡迎在選課系統落選，但有興趣的同學前來聆聽課程說明並參加抽籤。
3. 本課程之進度與排序﹑相關評分規定都將視實際情況進行調整，最終依據開學後公佈之內容為準。
course.objectives:
深化對近現代日本社會的客觀理解，與對台灣多元文化發展的認識
。
繫起日本社會文化與自身的連結，用更宏觀或更微觀的角度進行在地反思。
藉課程之內容與討論之過程，強化分析﹑批判能力，與對日常生活之洞察力和好奇心。
培養成為「知日派」的潛力，不再容易陷入單一的「親日」、「哈日」、「反日」等情結。

course.description:
본 과목은 한국어의 바른 사용을 위해 한국어 문법과 문형을 익히고, 익힌 내용을 충분히 연습하여 숙달하는 것을 목표로 한다. 중국어에는 없는 한국어 조사 및 어미의 용법과, 유사한 문법 표현들의 의미적 차이도 다양한 예를 통해 익히고 연습한다.
本課程旨在為了正確使用韓語，學習韓語的文法與句型，並透過充分的練習熟練所學內容。課程亦將透過多樣化的例句，學習並練習中文中沒有的韓語助詞與語尾的用法，以及相似文法表達之間的語義差異。
course.objectives:
한국어의 실제 사용에 필요한 어법을 이해하고 한국어의 특징을 충분히 이해하고 연습할 수 있다. 쓰임과 의미가 비슷한 문법을 서로 비교하여 가장 적절하게 사용할 수 있는 능력을 배양한다.
能夠理解韓語實際運用所需的語法規則，並充分理解韓語的特點，透過練習加以掌握。透過比較用法與意義相近的文法表達，培養在不同語境中選擇並恰當運用最合適文法的能力。

course.description:
This course introduces students to the foundational questions, themes, and perspectives of Korean Studies. It is designed as a preparatory course for students who will continue to take more advanced courses in Korean language, Korean culture, Korean society, Korean history, and Korean politics.
Rather than treating Korea simply as a geographical place or Korean culture as a collection of traditions, this course asks a broader question:
What is Korea, and who are Koreans?
To answer this question, students will examine how Korean identity has been shaped through history, language, nationalism, geopolitics, popular culture, everyday life, and social change.
The course begins with the historical experiences that have shaped Koreans’ strong concern with survival and national dignity. It then moves to modern and contemporary Korean society, particularly socio-historical background of K-pop. In doing so, it covers nationalism, generational change, relations with Japan and China. Lastly, this course offers how Koreans (particularly young generations) have maintained everyday life. Through these topics, students will gain basic knowledge and analytical perspectives necessary for understanding Korea in a more systematic and critical way.
course.objectives:
Objectives:
To acquire basic knowledge necessary to understand Korean society by covering a wide range of topics such as everyday life, culture, history, society, and politics.
To explore key concepts, values, events, cultural phenomena, and heritage relevant to understanding Korean society, and to understand how these elements are interconnected.
To clarify misunderstandings about Korean society and introduce how Koreans have thought and lived in practice.
To explore similarities and differences between Korea and students’ own countries through comparative analysis of each topic.
Learning Outcomes:
Develop a foundational and comprehensive understanding of Korea.
Cultivate the ability to explore and present topics of personal interest.
Gain comparative insight into Korean and students’ own societies.

course.description: 本課程由國立故宮博物院與韓國語文學系、阿拉伯語文學系共同規劃開設，結合理論知識、博物館導覽實務與跨文化溝通能力培養，旨在培育具備故宮文物知識與韓語、阿拉伯語導覽能力之人才。課程透過跨領域合作，使學生在認識故宮典藏與導覽技巧的同時，進一步理解韓國及阿拉伯世界之歷史文化、藝術特色與文物內涵，並學習如何將博物館專業知識轉譯為符合不同文化背景之導覽內容。課程內容涵蓋故宮文物賞析、博物館導覽理論與實務、跨文化溝通、韓國與阿拉伯世界文化及代表性文物介紹，以及文物外語轉譯與導覽演練。其中9週由故宮專業講師講授故宮典藏文物、博物館教育、導覽技巧及相關專題；另7週由韓國語文學系與阿拉伯語文學系教師介紹韓國及阿拉伯地區文化特色、代表性文物、文化比較及外語導覽表達技巧，並透過案例分析與口語演練，提升學生跨文化導覽能力。課程第14週安排學生赴故宮博物院進行實地參訪與導覽實作，由館方專業人員提供現場教學與回饋，強化理論與實務之連結。
course.objectives:
課程目標本課程旨在培養學生兼具博物館知識、外語能力與跨文化素養，透過故宮文物導覽與跨文化學習，使學生能
1. 建立故宮博物院典藏文物及博物館教育之基本知識。
2. 熟悉博物館導覽流程、解說技巧與觀眾互動方法。
3. 理解韓國及阿拉伯世界之歷史文化、藝術發展與代表性文物特色。
4. 培養文物知識之外語轉譯能力，學習以韓語或阿拉伯語進行文化詮釋。
5. 提升跨文化溝通能力，理解不同文化背景觀眾之需求與觀點。
6. 培養團隊合作、導覽企劃及實務應用能力，增進文化推廣與國際交流素養。
學習成效學生完成本課程後，預期能夠：
1. 對故宮博物院之館藏特色、典藏脈絡及博物館功能具有基本認識。
2. 理解故宮重要文物之歷史背景、藝術特色及文化價值。
3. 掌握博物館導覽之基本技巧，包括導覽規劃、口語表達、觀眾互動及臨場應變能力。
4. 認識韓國及阿拉伯世界重要文化、藝術特色及代表性文物，並能進行跨文化比較分析。
5. 能以韓語或阿拉伯語介紹故宮代表性文物，運用適切的專業詞彙及導覽表達方式。
6. 能依不同文化背景之參觀者需求，調整導覽內容與溝通策略，展現跨文化理解與文化敏感度。
7. 能完成故宮文物外語導覽實作，具備基礎導覽解說及文化推廣能力。
8. 培養文化保存、國際交流及博物館教育之基本素養，為未來從事博物館、文化觀光、國際交流或外語導覽相關工作奠定基礎。

course.titleZh: 現代韓國的國家權力與民族認同
course.titleEn: State Power and National Identity in Modern Korea
course.description:
Course Overview:
This course introduces students to key questions in Korean society and politics by asking a seemingly simple but theoretically complex question:
Who, or what, is “Korean”?
Rather than treating Korean identity as something natural, fixed, or culturally self-evident, the course examines how “Koreanness” has been historically constructed through state power and its influence on Korean society. It mainly covers nationalism, geopolitics, and anti-communism.
The course focuses especially on the ways in which state power has shaped Korean national identity. It explores how the Korean state has defined the nation, mobilized citizens, disciplined social behavior, and produced particular understandings of citizenship, sacrifice, survival, development, democracy, and belonging. In this sense, the course is concerned not only with Korean politics as institutions or events, but also with the deeper political question of how human beings become members of a nation, a people, and a political community.
*This course is designed as the first part of a broader sequence.
While this semester focuses on the formation of Koreanness through state power, a later course will examine how Korean identity has also been shaped through displinary power engendered by social interaction, popular culture, gender, class, and everyday life.
course.objectives:
Course Objectives
By the end of the course, students will be able to:
Understand the difference between state power and disciplinary power in the formation of national identity.
Explain how nationalism, geopolitics, and anti-communism have shaped modern Korean identity and still influenced on Korea
Analyze how state institutions, historical events, political ideologies, and collective memories have contributed to the construction of Koreanness.
Critically assess the continuing relevance of nationalism, anti-communism, geopolitical insecurity, inequality, and gender politics in contemporary Korea.
Develop the ability to compare the trajectory of nationality formation in Korea and students’ own countries
Learning Outcomes
After successfully completing this course, students should be able to:
Explain how national identity is historically and politically constructed rather than naturally given.
Analyze the relationship between individuals, society, and the state in the Korean context.
Discuss how the Korean state has shaped ideas of who Koreans are and what
Interpret contemporary cultural and political phenomena—such as K-pop, “national pride,” and the current martial law issue—in relation to the historical formation of Korean identity.
Find the critical similarity and difference between Korea and students’ own countries’ national identity

course.description:
本計畫為本系推動學生國際移動與專業能力培養之重要方案。2026年韓國暑期研修團隊將由權景祿老師帶領學生前往高麗大學，參與其韓國語學堂所規劃之短期密集課程，與來自多個國家之學生共同修習韓語課程。
本計畫除語言能力提升外，更強調跨文化溝通能力與國際學術環境適應能力之培養。
課後與週末期間，將安排參訪韓國國會及首爾重要文化遺產場域，透過實地觀察與導覽討論，深化學生對韓國政治制度與歷史文化脈絡之理解，進而培養其國際視野與獨立思考能力。
course.objectives:
本次研修計畫為期三週，內容以語言能力提升為基礎，並結合專業連結與跨文化能力培養為核心目標，整體規劃涵蓋語言學習、學術環境體驗與文化實地觀察三大面向。
首先，學生將依程度分班，與來自不同國家之國際學生共同修習韓語密集課程。課程內容包括韓文文法，以及聽、說、讀、寫之整合式訓練，並透過小班互動與多元教學方式，強化學生實際語言運用能力與學術語言表達能力。此種沉浸式學習環境，有助於學生在短期內顯著提升語言能力與跨文化溝通能力。
其次，高麗大學於課程期間規劃特色課程與文化體驗活動。特色課程每週2次、每次2小時，三週共計12小時，內容結合韓國社會文化、歷史發展與當代議題討論，使學生能將語言學習與社會脈絡相互連結。另安排2次文化體驗活動，透過實地參與與導覽說明，深化學生對韓國文化之理解。
此外，本計畫強調專業訓練與現地觀察之結合。將安排參訪大韓民國國會及相關藝文機構，並由教師帶領學生走訪首爾代表性文化場域，包括景福宮、首爾四大門、國立中央博物館及乙支路街區等。透過現場導覽與課後討論，培養學生從歷史、制度與當代文化發展等多重面向理解韓國社會之能力。
整體而言，本研修計畫不僅著重語言能力培養，更強調國際移動能力、跨文化理解能力與專業視野之拓展，符合本校推動學生國際化與全球競爭力提升之目標。

course.description:
探討韓國自二戰解殖以來的政治發展與民主化歷程。
梳理從李承晚、朴正熙至全斗煥時期的威權政權鞏固過程，以及歷次憲政體制演變背後的統治邏輯。並聚焦民間社會的反抗動能，解析「四一九革命」、「光州民主化運動」與「六月抗爭」等重大歷史事件，探討其推動國家民主轉型的關鍵作用。
另透過剖析歷史真相調查與轉型正義的記憶書寫，引導同學以批判性角度，反思韓國在民主鞏固後，所面臨的社會裂痕與歷史遺緒課題。
course.objectives: 掌握韓國發展成為現今民主國家的關鍵轉折，探究其獨特的國家發展體制。培養同學的比較視野，使大家能以批判性思維檢視東亞威權轉型與轉型正義中的國家暴力及歷史記憶建構過程。期望最終能將這些歷史縱深轉化為對當代社會的深刻反思，透徹理解當今韓國政黨政治、財閥體制，以及世代與性別矛盾的深層歷史根源。

course.description: 本課程針對具備韓語基礎能力之進階學習者（以二年級學生為主，難易度不適合高年級生），配合韓國諺語與文化的教材，介紹韓國諺語的產生、基本構造以及用法。同時利用教材中出現的各種文化題材，在學習過程中比較臺、韓兩國民俗上的差異與相同點，以期學生能對韓國民俗文化有更深一層的理解。
course.objectives:
1.理解諺語中蘊含的意義，減少對韓國文化的誤解。
2.藉由諺語比較兩國文化的異同，加深彼此的理解。
3.透過諺語的活用，於生活中增進韓語的溝通效率。

course.description:
한국의 지리를 공부합니다.
한국의 지리, 곧 한국의 자연(自然)과 인문(人文), 그리고 지지(地誌)를 공부힙니다.
지리를 배우면, 한국을 여행할 때 더 많이 보고 듣고 느낄 수 있습니다.
수업은 중급 수준의 한국어로 진행합니다.
course.objectives:
자연지리학(自然地理學):
한국의 지형(地形)을 주로 배웁니다.
인문지리학(人文地理學):
한국의 도시(都市)와 인구(人口)에 대해 배웁니다.
지지(地誌):
한국 여러 지역의 위치와 지역성(地域性)을 배웁니다.

course.objectives:
1.
한국영화와드라마를감상하고주요내용과표현을이해할수있다.

예술에나타나는한국사회와문화를이해하고설명할수있다.

4.
한국문화와 자신의 문화를 비교하며 비판적으로 감상할 수 있다.

course.titleZh: 土耳其語視聽與會話（一）
course.description:
Bu ders, öğrencilerin A1 ve A2 seviyesindeki Türkçe dinleme ve anlama becerilerini geliştirmeyi amaçlamaktadır. Ders, öğrencilerin günlük yaşamda karşılaşabilecekleri çeşitli durumlarda konuşulan Türkçeyi anlamalarını ve bu becerileri etkili şekilde kullanmalarını sağlamaya odaklanır. Ayrıca ders, Avrupa Dilleri Ortak Çerçeve Programı (CEFR) çerçevesinde A1-A2 seviyesine uygun pratik konuları kapsar. Her bir ders saatinde, öğrencilerin dili hem anlamaya hem de kullanmaya aktif olarak katılmalarını sağlayan dinleme alıştırmaları, diyaloglar ve konuşma etkinliklerini içerir. Öğrencilerin öğrenme çıktıları, ara ve final sınavlarıyla değerlendirilir.
本課程旨在培養學生 A1 至 A2 程度的土耳其語聽力與理解能力，幫助學生在日常生活中的各種情境下理解土耳其語口語內容，並能有效運用於實際溝通。本課程依據歐洲共同語言參考架構（CEFR）設計，涵蓋符合 A1-A2 程度的實用主題。每堂課包含聽力練習、對話以及口說活動，讓學生能積極參與語言理解與表達。學生的學習成果將透過期中考與期末考進行評量。
course.objectives:
Bu ders, öğrencilerin A1-A2 seviyesindeki Türkçe dinleme ve konuşma becerilerini geliştirmelerine yardımcı olur. Dersin sonunda öğrenciler, günlük hayatta sık karşılaşılan durumlarda konuşulan Türkçeyi anlayabilecek ve uygun kelime ve ifadelerle basit sohbetlere katılabileceklerdir. Böylece, dinleme ve konuşma becerilerinde özgüven kazanarak günlük hayatta daha etkili iletişim kuracaklardır.
本課程旨在提升學生
A1
至
A2
程度的土耳其語聽力與口說能力。課程結束後，學生將能理解日常生活中常見情境下的土耳其語對話，並運用適當的詞彙與句型參與簡單交流。學生也將增強聽說方面的自信，並能在日常生活中更有效地使用土耳其語進行溝通。

course.titleEn: Seminar on Turkish Culture and History
course.description:
Bu ders, bir akademik yıl boyunca iki dönem hâlinde verilmektedir. İlk dönemde, Avrasya coğrafyasında göçebe ve yerleşik halklar arasındaki ilişkiler çerçevesinde Türk halklarının tarihsel gelişimi ele alınacaktır. Türklerin göç tarihi, kurdukları devletler, toplumsal yapıları, sosyal değişim süreçleri ile Türkiye Cumhuriyeti’nin kuruluşuna zemin hazırlayan tarihî ve siyasî koşullar incelenecektir.
İkinci dönemde ise Türk kültürü çeşitli yönleriyle işlenecektir: dil, edebiyat, gelenekler, inanç sistemleri ve günlük yaşam gibi konular üzerinde durulacaktır. Ders sonunda öğrencilerin, geçmişten günümüze uzanan bir perspektifle Türk tarihine ve kültürüne dair bütüncül bir anlayış geliştirmeleri hedeflenmektedir.
(Bu ders, Türk Dili ve Kültürü Bölümü öğrencileri için hazırlanmıştır. Ders kapsamında orta düzeyde Türkçe bilgisi gerektiren konular yer aldığından,
diğer bölümlerden öğrencilerin alması için uygun olmayabilir.
)
本課程為全學年課程，分為上下兩學期授課。上學期將以歐亞大陸游牧與定居民族之關係為框架，探討突厥民族的歷史發展。內容包含突厥民族的遷徙史、所建立的政權、社會結構、社會變遷歷程，以及為土耳其共和國奠基之歷史與政治背景。
下學期則將多角度探討土耳其文化，著重於語言、文學、傳統習俗、信仰體系及日常生活等主題。本課程旨在培養學生以貫穿古今的視野，建立對土耳其歷史與文化的整體性認識。
（
本課程專為土耳其語文學系學生設計。由於課程內容包含需具備中級土耳其語能力之主題，可能不適合其他系所學生修讀。
）
course.objectives: Bu iki dönemlik dersin amacı, öğrencilerin Türk dünyasının hem tarihî hem de kültürel yönlerini kapsamlı bir biçimde kavramalarını sağlamaktır. İlk dönemde öğrenciler, göçebe ve yerleşik toplumlar arasındaki ilişkileri analiz edebilecek; Türklerin göç hareketlerini, devlet kurma süreçlerini ve Türkiye Cumhuriyeti'nin kuruluşunu hazırlayan sosyopolitik dönüşümleri değerlendirebilecektir. İkinci dönemde ise öğrenciler; Türklere ait dil, sözlü ve yazılı kültür, geleneksel inanışlar ve günlük yaşam uygulamaları gibi temel kültürel unsurları inceleyebilecektir. Dersin sonunda öğrencilerin, Türk tarihini ve kültürünü bütüncül ve bağlamsal bir bakış açısıyla yorumlayabilmeleri beklenmektedir.

course.description: 本課程的主要目的是視伊朗為一個國家、一個仍在延續的文明的發源地以及伊斯蘭和中東文化運動的引擎，以此向學生介紹。由於語言障礙以及西方視角在伊朗問題上的普遍性，學生們經常難以找到關於伊朗的第一手資料。大多數學者傾向於複製西方學者對伊朗的解釋，這導致他們無法對伊朗形成平衡、中立和客觀的認識。我將力求在解釋中避免任何主觀因素，並清楚地描繪伊朗作為一個國家及其政府的全貌。
course.objectives: 修此課之學生將可對伊朗這個國家、對伊斯蘭、對藝術與文化有全面性的瞭解。並進而對中東與伊斯蘭世界具備判斷的能力。

course.description:
Türk mutfağı, Orta Asya, Anadolu, Balkanlar, Akdeniz ve Orta Doğu'nun mutfak geleneklerini bir araya getiren, köklü bir tarihe ve zengin bir kültürel mirasa sahip önemli bir mutfaktır. Zenginliği ve çeşitliliği sayesinde  uzun zamandır uluslararası alanda büyük ilgi görmekte ve takdir edilmektedir. Yemek kültürü yalnızca günlük yaşamın bir parçası değil, aynı zamanda bir ülkenin tarihini, kültürünü, dinini ve toplumsal yapısını anlamada önemli bir araçtır.
Bu ders, Türk mutfak kültürünü merkeze alarak öğrencilerin yiyecekler, beslenme alışkanlıkları, bölgesel özellikler ve sosyo-kültürel bağlamlar aracılığıyla gerçek yaşam durumlarında Türkçe kullanım becerilerini geliştirmeyi amaçlamaktadır. Ders yalnızca “yemek” olgusuyla sınırlı kalmayıp günlük beslenme alışkanlıkları, bayram yemekleri, sokak lezzetleri, misafirperverlik kültürü, sofra adabı ve yemekle ilgili çeşitli konuları kapsamaktadır. B1 düzeyindeki öğrencilerin video materyalleri, metin okumaları, tartışmalar ve yoluyla kültürlerarası farkındalıklarını, dilsel uygulama becerilerini ve iletişim yetkinliklerini geliştirmeleri hedeflenmektedir.
土耳其料理歷史悠久，融合中亞、安納托利亞、巴爾幹、地中海及中東等地的飲食特色，發展出豐富多元且具深厚文化底蘊的飲食文化，長期在國際間受到關注與肯定。飲食不僅是日常生活的重要部分，更是認識一個國家歷史、文化、宗教及社會的重要媒介。
本課程以土耳其飲食文化為核心，透過食物、飲食習慣、地域特色及社會文化脈絡，培養學生在真實情境中的土耳其語應用能力。課程不僅停留在「吃」，課程內容涵蓋日常飲食、節慶料理、街頭小吃、待客文化、餐桌禮儀及飲食相關議題。讓學生在
B1
的語言程度下，結合影片、文本閱讀及討論，提升學生跨文化理解能力與語言實踐能力。

3. Öğrencilerin yemek ve restoran ortamlarında iletişim kurma becerilerini geliştirmek.
4. Öğrencilerin kültürel olguları analiz etme ve kültürlerarası karşılaştırma yapma becerilerini kazandırmak.

認識土耳其飲食文化之歷史背景與發展。

3.
培養學生在餐飲情境中的溝通能力。

course.titleEn: Living Nomadic Traditions in Central Asia
course.description: This graduate course examines nomadic traditions of Central Asian peoples as living, evolving practices rather than relics of the past. Drawing on ethnography, oral history, material culture studies, and contemporary fieldwork, students will explore how nomadic ways of life—pastoral herding, portable architecture, oral epic poetry, seasonal migrations, and traditional crafts—continue to shape daily life, identity, and community across the region today. Special attention is given to how nomadic heritage is negotiated, preserved, and transformed in the context of modernization, urbanization, and state-building in the post-Soviet era. The course combines thematic lectures with guest seminars by scholars and practitioners from Central Asia.
course.objectives:
Course Objectives:
To introduce students to nomadic traditions as dynamic, living cultural systems in Central Asia
To examine the material, social, and symbolic dimensions of nomadic life—from yurts and herding to oral poetry and ritual
To analyze how nomadic traditions are preserved, adapted, or contested in modern Central Asian societies
To develop students' ability to use ethnographic and comparative methods in analyzing non-Western cultural practices
To foster cross-cultural understanding through direct engagement with scholars and practitioners from the region
Learning Outcomes:
Students will be able to identify and describe key nomadic traditions across different Central Asian groups
Students will critically analyze the relationship between nomadic heritage and contemporary identity politics
Students will demonstrate understanding of how material culture, oral traditions, and everyday practices intersect
Students will develop comparative analytical skills applicable to cultural studies and area studies research
Students will engage productively with primary sources—including oral testimonies, ethnographic texts, and cultural artifacts

course.titleZh: 土耳其語數位故事創作
course.description:
數位故事指的是用各類多媒體工具描述事件的一種敘事方式，其敘事類型相當彈性，主題也包羅萬象，例如解釋某個概念、反思個人經驗、重述一個歷史事件、或是提出一個論點。數位故事是一種結合影音、影像、或影片等成果，要完成一個數位故事除了要發揮想像力和文章組織能力之外，也需要編輯和剪輯的技巧。
本課程是一門結合土耳其語學習和數位故事創作的創新課程，結合語言學習與個人敘事，引導學生透過影片創作的歷程，深度反思自身的外語學習經驗。學生將從察覺自身的「困惑/謎團」(puzzle) 出發，透過起承轉合的敘事結構，將土耳其語學習歷程書寫成腳本，經歷錄音配音、視覺素材收集、雙語字幕製作和數位剪輯等階段，最終完成一隻至少三分鐘以上的土耳其語數位故事。
本課程採取鷹架式教學和同儕合作模式，教師提供語言、文法和發音技巧訓練，並鼓勵學生在以不依賴翻譯軟體的前提下，以土耳其文進行真實的情感表達。學生每週透過反思日記和小組討論，培養學生深度理解其學習歷程和當中在學習者認同上的看法，進而提升未來土耳其語學習能力。
course.objectives:
修完本課程後，學生將能夠：
語言表達能力
：
能運用土耳其語描述過去經驗，同時運用特定詞彙或句型表達情感
數位敘事能力
：
能完整的說出故事，並結合各種數位工具來產出數位故事影片
反思能力
：
透過反思日記，深入分析自身土耳其語學習的困惑 (puzzle)，並
察覺自身在過程中值得探究挖掘的面相
同儕合作能力：在腳本共審、配音實作和影片互評中，以尊重、支持、欣賞的態度給予建設性的回饋
跨文化能力：透過視覺素材，呈現對土耳其語言和文化的連結

course.titleEn: Learning Turkish Through Advertisements: Ad Analysis and Creative Writing
course.description:
本課程旨在透過土耳其當代經典與流行廣告（包含電視廣告、平面廣告、社群媒體業配），帶領學生深入探討土耳其的消費文化、社會價值觀與幽默感。學生將學習如何「解讀」廣告背後的文化密碼，並透過文案改寫、腳本創作等創意寫作練習，將

Öğrenciler reklamların arkasındaki kültürel kodları nasıl “çözeceklerini” öğrenecek; reklam metnini yeniden yazma ve senaryo tasarımı gibi yaratıcı yazma alıştırmalarıyla B1 seviyesindeki kelime ve dil bilgisi birikimlerini ikna edici ve pratik bir dil çıktısına dönüştüreceklerdir.

修完本課程後，學生將能夠：
廣告解讀力

創意寫作力

運用土耳其語撰寫具有吸引力的廣告標語
與微電影短片腳本。
文化感應力
：
理解土耳其人在家庭、節慶、飲食等層面的核心社會心理與消費行為。
Bu dersin sonunda öğrenciler şunları yapabilecektir:
Reklam Çözümleme Kapasitesi: Türk reklamlarındaki çift anlamlı sözleri, mecazları ve popüler kültür ögelerini anlayıp analiz edebilirler.

Kültürel Duyarlılık: Türk toplumunun aile, bayramlar ve beslenme gibi konulardaki temel sosyal psikolojisini ve tüketici davranışlarını kavrayabilirler.

course.titleZh: 探索土耳其：觀光與文化地理
course.titleEn: Discover Turkiye: Tourism and Cultural Geography
course.description:
土耳其位於古代文明世界的中心地帶，地理位置橫跨歐洲與亞洲，並連結黑海、地中海與中東地區，自古以來即為不同文明交流的重要樞紐。由於其特殊的地理位置與悠久歷史，土耳其境內保存了豐富多元的文化遺產，包括史前遺跡、古代城市、宗教建築以及鄂圖曼時期的重要文化景觀。
本課程以土耳其觀光與文化地理為核心，透過歷史發展、地理環境、民族文化與世界遺產等面向，引導學生探索土耳其各地的重要文化景點。課程將介紹聯合國教科文組織（
UNESCO
）世界遺產的概念與保存制度，並深入探討土耳其代表性的文化與自然遺產。透過地圖分析、文本閱讀、影音教材、案例討論及文化比較活動，旨在培養學生以土耳其語理解與介紹土耳其歷史文化景觀的能力，提升其跨文化理解與觀光溝通能力。
Eski uygarlıklar dünyasının merkezinde yer alan Türkiye; Avrupa ve Asya kıtalarını birbirine bağlayan, Karadeniz, Akdeniz ve Orta Doğu bölgeleriyle temas hâlinde olan konumuyla, tarih boyunca farklı medeniyetlerin buluştuğu önemli bir kavşak noktası olmuştur. Bu özel coğrafi konumu ve köklü tarihi sayesinde Türkiye; tarih öncesi kalıntılardan antik kentlere, dinî yapılardan Osmanlı dönemine ait önemli kültürel peyzajlara kadar oldukça zengin ve çeşitli bir kültürel mirasa ev sahipliği yapmaktadır.
Bu ders, Türkiye'nin turizm ve kültür coğrafyasını merkeze alarak; tarihsel gelişim, coğrafi çevre, etnografik kültür ve dünya mirası gibi boyutlar aracılığıyla öğrencilerin Türkiye'nin farklı bölgelerindeki önemli kültürel mekânları keşfetmelerine rehberlik etmeyi amaçlar. Ders kapsamında Birleşmiş Milletler Eğitim, Bilim ve Kültür Örgütü (UNESCO) Dünya Mirası kavramı ile koruma sistemleri tanıtılacak, Türkiye’nin simge niteliğindeki kültürel ve doğal mirasları derinlemesine incelenecektir. Harita analizleri, metin okumaları, görsel-işitsel materyaller, vaka tartışmaları ve kültürlerarası karşılaştırma etkinlikleriyle öğrencilerin Türkiye'nin tarihî ve kültürel peyzajlarını Türkçe kullanarak anlama ve tanıtma becerilerini geliştirmek, kültürlerarası anlayışlarını ve turizm iletişimi yetkinliklerini artırmak hedeflenmektedir.
course.objectives:
完成本課程後，學生將能夠：
認識現代土耳其疆域形成的歷史背景與文化發展。
理解安納托利亞地區從古代文明至現代土耳其的歷史脈絡。
了解
UNESCO
世界遺產公約與文化遺產保存的重要性。
認識土耳其主要世界遺產及其歷史、文化與地理特色。
運用土耳其語介紹土耳其重要觀光景點與文化遺產。
培養分析文化景觀與進行跨文化比較的能力。
Bu dersin sonunda öğrenciler;
Günümüz Türkiye sınırlarının oluşumundaki tarihî arka planı ve kültürel gelişimi öğrenebileceklerdir.
Anadolu'nun antik uygarlıklardan günümüz Türkiye'sine kadar olan tarihsel çizgisini anlayabileceklerdir.
UNESCO Dünya Mirası Sözleşmesi ve kültürel mirasın korunmasının önemini kavrayabileceklerdir.
Türkiye'nin öne çıkan dünya miras alanlarını tarihî, kültürel ve coğrafi özellikleriyle tanıyabileceklerdir.
Türkiye'nin önemli turistik mekânlarını ve kültürel miraslarını Türkçe kullanarak tanıtabileceklerdir.
Kültürel peyzajları analiz etme ve kültürlerarası karşılaştırma yapma becerilerini geliştirebileceklerdir.

course.description:
Ce cours de première année de FLE s’adresse à des apprenants débutants et vise l’acquisition progressive des compétences orales du niveau A1 du CECRL. Il peut egalement préparer à l’épreuve orale du DELF A1. L’enseignement alterne apports théoriques et activités pratiques afin de développer la compréhension et la production orales dans des situations de communication simples. Durant le premier semestre, les étudiants se familiarisent avec le vocabulaire fondamental et les expressions courantes. Le travail en classe repose sur des exercices interactifs, des jeux de rôle et des activités d’écoute, en lien étroit avec les unités du manuel
La Nouvelle Génération A1
. Une seconde phase est consacrée à la fin du manuel et le début de
La Nouvelle Génération A2
pour l’acquisition progressive des compétences orales du niveau A2 du CECRL.
Manuels requis:
Didier. (2022).
La Nouvelle Génération A1 : Méthode de français
. Édition illustrée. ISBN 978-2278104086.
course.objectives:
Objectifs du cours :
Introduire et consolider le vocabulaire spécifique et les expressions attendues au niveau A1.
Développer la compréhension de l’oral à travers des documents authentiques et semi-authentiques.
Renforcer la capacité à interagir et s’exprimer à l’oral dans des situations de communication simples.
Permettre aux apprenants d’atteindre le niveau A1-2 du CECRL en production et compréhension orales.
Le syllabus est à titre indicatif et est sujet à changement suivant l'évolution et la progression de la classe.

course.description:
This course aims to introduce German at a beginners level. Guided by a native speaker students will gain firsthand experience in communicating in the German language as well as a basic view onto the German culture. Students will practice content-orientated short dialogues for everyday situations with study partners or groups and present them in class. The teacher’s correction of the students’ performance will improve their ability to speak and understand short simple German sentences at the beginners level.
NCCU encourages students to gain self-learning experiences. Students should use additional materials, e.g., visiting the NCCU e-moodle platform, DW Deutsche Welle online learning courses, etc.
course.objectives:
The goal of this course is to enable students to communicate successfully in simple German on a basic level (i.e. Common European Framework of Reference for Languages level A1). German vocabulary and pronunciation will be introduced. This will help the students’ ability to talk and to understand simple German sentences. Students will learn how to talk in simple standard German and practice exchanging uncomplicated information.
Weekly homework assignments including previewing the lesson and revising their assignments will be required. Students will work in groups or with study partners. After each chapter an oral test mostly in form of a free-spoken dialogue in German will be given. Each student’s absentee hours must be under 25% of the total scheduled classroom hours; otherwise the student’s results cannot be accepted.

course.description:
Ce cours s’adresse aux grands débutants en français et a pour but de les initier à l’apprentissage des structures fondamentales de la grammaire française. La grammaire est parfois considérée dans l’apprentissage d’une langue comme un domaine difficile et rébarbatif. A travers des explications simples, des rappels systématiques des acquis et un contrôle continu des progrès accomplis, ce cours se propose de démontrer aux étudiants que la notion de « règle », souvent dévalorisée, est, au contraire, ce qui permet de construire une connaissance rigoureuse de la langue étudiée. Le programme de ce premier semestre correspond aux Unités 1-4 du manuel utilisé :
Nouvelle
Génération A1.
course.objectives:

Initier l’apprenant à la grammaire française à travers des explications simples, des exemples clairs et de nombreux exercices structuraux

Travailler la prononciation (intonations, liaisons…)

course.description:
1. 本課程內容為基礎西班牙語文法
,
教授方式以循序漸進為原則。考量同學所接觸之第一外國語為英文
,
故安排第一堂課為此課程之導論
,
以介紹西語國家文化及語言發展為主。待同學對今日西語國家之語言文化分部及發展
,
有概略性的認識後
,
再於後續課程講解西班牙語文法。
2. 西語國家幅員遼闊
,
涵蓋位於歐洲之西班牙
,
及中南美洲除巴西外各國。西班牙語於
15
世紀隨西班牙殖民計畫進入中南美洲後
,
便在各地產生些微變化
,
不僅相同字彙指稱的意思有所分歧
,
各地語法也不盡相同
,
因此偶有誤會或溝通不良的情形產生。本課程以西班牙皇家語言學院所制訂之語法及詞彙解釋為標準
,
輔以中南美洲常見的不同用法補充之。

學習基本西文字彙結構及文法規則。
培養基本句型分析能力，並能造出完整的簡單句。
訓練熟記基本句型，運用於日常生活對話中。

The present course aims to help students develop their oral communicative abilities by fostering their listening and speaking skills. The course will strengthen students' knowledge and communicative competence to correspond to an intermediate level. This will ensure that students reach and exceed the threshold of the A2 level of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.
The course offers numerous exercises and activities to practice (such as role plays, guessing games, and discussions). Students are required to participate actively in all these activities.

course.description:
Ce cours d’expression orale s’adresse à des étudiant·es de troisième année en FLE visant à consolider et enrichir leurs compétences d’interaction et de production orale autour de thématiques contemporaines. Il s’appuie notamment sur le manuel
Nouvelle génération B2
(Didier, 2023)
et sur
Prêt-à-parler 4
(Maison des langues, 2025)
,
qui propose des situations authentiques, des documents oraux variés (entretiens, reportages, témoignages) et des activités stim
ulantes favorisant la prise de parole et la réflexion critique.
Les apprenant·es sont amené·es à débattre, argumenter, raconter, présenter des projets et réagir à des problématiques de société, tout en développant une aisance orale, une fluidité d’expression et une prononciation plus naturelle. Le cours favorise également l'autonomie à l'oral, le travail en groupe, et l'utilisation d’un lexique précis et nuancé.
course.objectives:
À l’issue de ce cours, les étudiant·es seront capables de :
Participer activement à des discussions ou débats sur des sujets variés (engagement citoyen, environnement, travail, société, culture…).
Organiser un discours oral structuré, cohérent et adapté à un public cible (exposé, opinion, présentation de projet…).
Argumenter et défendre un point de vue personnel de manière convaincante.
Réagir spontanément à des situations simulées proches de la vie quotidienne ou professionnelle.
Employer un vocabulaire riche et approprié aux thématiques traitées dans
Nouvelle génération B2
.
Améliorer la prononciation, l’intonation et la fluidité à travers des exercices de reformulation, jeux de rôles et simulations.
Acquérir des outils méthodologiques pour la prise de parole en continu et l’interaction orale en contexte universitaire ou professionnel.

course.description: Dieser Kurs zielt darauf ab, die Deutschkenntnisse auf fortgeschrittenem Niveau zu erweitern. Unter Anleitung eines Muttersprachlers sammeln die Studierenden praktische Erfahrungen in der deutschen Sprache und vertiefen ihr Verständnis der deutschen Kultur. Sie üben inhaltsbezogene Dialoge für die allgemeine Kommunikation – allein, mit Lernpartnern oder in Gruppen – und präsentieren diese im Kurs. Die Studierenden verbessern ihre Fähigkeit, sich über allgemeine Themen zu unterhalten und Informationen in Standarddeutsch auszutauschen. Die NCCU fördert selbstständiges Lernen.
course.objectives:
Ziel dieses Kurses ist es, den Studierenden zu ermöglichen, sich erfolgreich auf fortgeschrittenem Niveau (d. h. gemäß dem Gemeinsamen Europäischen Referenzrahmen für Sprachen, Niveau B1) in anspruchsvollerem Deutsch zu verständigen und mehr über kulturelle Unterschiede zu erfahren. Die Semantik und Aussprache des differenzierten Standarddeutschen werden vermittelt, um die Fähigkeit der Studierenden zu verbessern, in verschiedenen Kontexten und zu spezifischen Themen deutsche Sätze zu bilden.
Schwerpunkt ist die mündliche Kompetenz sowie der Ausbau des Hörverstehens.
Gelegentlich sind Hausaufgaben erforderlich, darunter die Vorbereitung auf den Unterricht und die Überarbeitung der Aufgaben. Es ist außerdem notwendig, außerhalb der Unterrichtszeiten zu lernen und in Gruppen oder mit Lernpartnern zusammenzuarbeiten. Zu jedem Kapitel gibt es einen kleinen Test, der das Erlernte abfragt. Die Teilnehmer dürfen maximal 25 % der gesamten Unterrichtszeit abwesend sein; andernfalls werden die Ergebnisse nicht anerkannt.

course.description:
本課程為大三學生開設之
法國文學概論
，以歐洲法語檢定 B1–B2 程度的選文讀本《Littérature progressive du français》(intermédiaire, 2e éd., CLE) 為主教材，輔以教師補充之作家與時代背景資料。
課程採
文學史縱貫
方式，自中世紀的武功歌與騎士文學起，循序介紹文藝復興、十七世紀古典主義、十八世紀啟蒙運動、十九世紀（浪漫主義、寫實主義、自然主義與象徵詩派），以迄二十至二十一世紀的現代與當代文學，並適度延伸至法語圈（francophonie）文學。每一時期透過代表作家的選文（extraits）進行精讀，搭配課本練習，建立學生對法國文學發展脈絡、主要思潮與文類（詩、戲劇、小說、散文）的整體認識。
course.objectives:
課程目標
建立法國文學史的時代分期與發展脈絡之整體框架。
認識各時期代表作家、代表作品與主要文學思潮（古典主義、啟蒙、浪漫主義、寫實／自然主義、象徵主義、超現實主義、存在主義與荒謬劇場等）。
培養閱讀與分析法文文學選文的基本能力，能辨識詩、戲劇、小說等不同文類的特徵。
提升以法文理解文本、並進行初步文本評析（commentaire）的能力。
學習成效
說明法國文學自中世紀至二十世紀各時期的分期、特徵與重要思潮。
指認主要作家及其代表作，並將作品置於其時代與思潮脈絡中理解。
閱讀並分析中等難度（B1–B2）的法文文學選文，掌握主題、語氣與基本修辭。
就指定選文進行口頭討論與簡要書面評析，奠定後續文學課程（如斷代史、文類專題）之基礎。

course.description:
This course is entirely taught in the German language by a native speaker. Students will get to know classical German authors as well as some of their most important literary works.* Some of the commonly used specific terms in German literature studies will be introduced. We will chronologically read and discuss a lot of exemplary German literature of many epochs in this course.
1) The planned content of this course (see the program below) needs to be carefully prepared by every student. Firstly, students have to work and find the vocabulary by themselves to be able to understand and discuss the different German literary texts. Therefore, it is necessary that every student prepares the announced program before every class by reading the assigned German literary text(s) in advance.  (Students should write down difficult words and phrases, and/or possible questions to ask in the next session. This is always the assigned homework for any student in this course.)
2) It is expected that students write their own protocol of each class session that later can be used as a preparation for the important final written examination.
3) Following the first two sessions, students will make a presentation at the beginning of every class (each time a different topic by a different student; usually in pairs), introducing thereby one specific German language author, his/her literary work(s) and time. All presentation topics are fixed to a date in chronological order.
The topics for each presentation will be distributed and assigned in the second session (the latest). All students will be assigned two topics by drawing lots in the second session. All students will get two topics for a presentation. (In case a student did not attend the first nor the second session, it will not be possible to get a presentation topic since all topics will have been distributed and assigend already.)
After the oral presentation by one or more students' groups, each session will consist of:
Q & A for the student presenter(s),
reading content description and original German language excerpts with the teacher,
conclusion/opening up of new questions.
Weekly mandatory homework: assigned readings (from the work sheets on the e-moodle learning platform) as preparation for the next session. NCCU encourages students to self learning.
*This course will continue in the second semester with other literary topics and leads to examples of contemporary German language literature.
course.objectives:
Through this course, students will have opportunities to get to know German language literature and cultures at a college level first hand. The goal of this course is to exemplarily introduce the development and transformation of German language and literature, including some of the most important German language authors and their works. At the same time, using the German language on a more advanced level, the students will get used to read and discuss selected German literary texts and excerpts from different literary trends and epochs of the so-called “history of literature”in this course. In this way, they will start to get a first overview of different texts by influential male and female German language literary authors. We will read aloud the get to know different the German language of different times. Also, we will learn that it is not only about vocabulary but also about the form and sound of a literary text that makes it interesting.
The knowledge of literary texts leads the students to a deeper understanding of German culture. Taking part in this course will mainly strengthen students’ reading skills, as well as their listening, conversational and writing skills in German language. Students are also expected to obtain (at least) the level of B1 according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR).

course.description:
Ce cours de français professionnel de niveau B2 s’adresse à des étudiants de 4 ème années et
sera focalisé sur les domaines de la diplomatie, des relations internationales et de la
communication institutionnelle. Il vise à renforcer les compétences langagières à l’oral
comme à l’écrit à travers sept thématiques structurantes : Au cœur de la diplomatie, Les
organisations internationales en première ligne, Au cœur du discours public, L’action, Le
protocole, Filles d’aujourd’hui, femmes de demain, et Ça fait débat !. À partir du manuel
Affaires étrangères, les apprenants découvriront le lexique spécialisé, les codes du discours
officiel, les formes d’expression publique et les enjeux sociétaux actuels. Ils apprendront à
produire des textes professionnels (notes, discours, lettres), à débattre de manière structurée,
à comprendre les mécanismes des relations internationales et à interagir dans un contexte
multiculturel formel. Le cours repose sur une pédagogie active (études de cas, simulations,
projets, débats) et prépare à une communication efficace dans le monde francophone
institutionnel.
Le syllabus est sujet à changement en fonction de la progression de la classe.

course.description:
In diesem Seminar wird das Konzept des
Flipped Classroom
angewendet. Da sich diese Lehrveranstaltung um einen Capstone-Kurs handelt, ist der Kursinhalt auf B2 Niveau gerichtet.
Der Unterricht gliedert sich in vier Phasen:
Gruppenpräsentation zum jeweiligen Thema
Diskussion und kritische Reflexion der präsentierten Inhalte im Plenum
Fachliche Kommentierung, Kontextualisierung und Vertiefung durch die Lehrperson
Erstellung eines schriftlichen Gruppenberichts zur Dokumentation und Zusammenfassung der Diskussionsergebnisse
Die für die jeweiligen Themen relevanten Texte und Materialien werden von der Lehrperson im Voraus bereitgestellt, um die eigenständige Themenrecherche, die kritische Reflexion sowie die Präsentation der Arbeitsergebnisse durch die Teilnehmenden zu fördern.
course.objectives: Ziel dieser Lehrveranstaltung ist es, die Deutschkenntnisse der Studierenden auszubauen, ihr Verständnis für die Kulturen deutschsprachiger Länder zu vertiefen und ihre interkulturelle Kompetenz zu stärken. Dadurch werden sie auf eine professionelle Tätigkeit in interkulturellen und internationalen Kontexten vorbereitet.

course.description:
本課程為大一新生開設之初級法文閱讀課，對象為
零基礎、初次接觸法文
的學生。
教學以閱讀理解為核心，兼顧字彙與基礎文法，培養學生辨識法文拼字與發音的對應、運用同源字與上下文猜測詞義，並能讀懂自我介紹、人物描寫、日常生活等 A1 程度的短文。一學期 16 週，預計完成第 0 單元（入門）至第 5 單元，第 6 單元與 DELF 模擬留待下學期。

建立法文「拼字—發音」對應觀念，能流暢朗讀簡單句子與短文。
累積 A1 程度的基礎字彙與必要文法，作為閱讀理解的後盾。
培養基本閱讀策略：辨識同源字、依上下文推測詞義、掃讀關鍵訊息。

讀懂主題為自我介紹、職業、人物外貌與性格、日常作息、購物飲食等的 A1 簡易短文，並回答理解性問題。
從文本中擷取具體訊息（人、事、時、地），完成身分卡、表格等資訊整理任務。

A1-A2 閱讀
水準，並為後續法文學習奠定發音與閱讀基礎。

Starter / A1

course.department: 歐文西二歐文西三歐文西四
course.description:
本課程預計前往西班牙，以西班牙北部
Cantabria
地區為核心，結合城市文化研究（
urbancultural studies
）、文化地景（
cultural landscape
）與社會科學視角（原文
:
田野調查方法），透過沉浸式學習引導學生觀察、記錄與分析在地文化現象。課程內容涵蓋歷史、城市空間、飲食文化、節慶、博物館與日常生活實踐，以質性研究中的田野調查方法，透過西班牙語（
A1-B2
程度）進行描述與反思，培養跨文化理解與文化表達能力。
course.objectives:
本課程旨在培育具備國際視野與社會觀察力的現代公民，具體目標如下：
社會脈絡與文化理解：理解
Cantabria
之歷史脈絡與在地文化形成。
社會科學研究方法實踐：掌握城市觀察、紀錄與文化分析方法，培養田野調查與
文化紀錄能力。
空間與文化分析能力：運用「文化地景」視角，分析城市空間（如廣場、市場、港口）中的社會互動與意義。
跨語言文化表達：強化西班牙語文化描述與簡報能力。
建立跨文化比較與批判思考：系統性比較台灣與西班牙在飲食、節慶、家庭等日常社會運作上的文化差異。
學習成效：
具備空間與社會結構的分析能力：學生能運用「文化地景」與城市文化研究的社會科學視角，解讀城市公共空間（如廣場、市場、港口等）背後的歷史脈絡，並分析這些空間如何形塑在地人群的社會互動與日常生活實踐。
實踐社會科學質性研究方法：學生能突破單向的知識接收，實際走入真實社會場域，掌握並運用質性研究中的「參與式觀察」、「在地訪談」與「田野紀錄」等工具，系統性地蒐集並解讀第一手社會資料。
建立跨文化批判與比較視野：學生能以客觀且具備文化相對論的眼光，比較台灣與西班牙在社會運作與日常實踐（如飲食共食文化、節慶記憶、家庭結構）上的差異，藉由理解異國社會來反思自身文化的框架與盲點。
展現跨語言社會觀察與學術論述能力：學生能將外語（西班牙語
A1–B2
程度）作為深入探索與描述異國文化現象的實用工具，並將複雜的田野觀察結果，轉化為具備邏輯論述與社會學反思深度的期末主題分析報告（含口頭簡報與書面呈現）。

course.description:
本課程旨在帶領學生初探法國人自幼開始欣賞戲劇的文化以及學校戲劇教育的規劃。另外也將介紹與法國劇場結構與推廣的文化政策及經濟策略。不僅從文學與藝術角度欣賞經典與現代劇作，更深入剖析當代法國劇場的「生態系統」。我們將探討法國特有的劇場組織文化，從具備百年歷史傳承的法蘭西劇院
（
Comédie-Française
）其獨特的組織結構與運作模式，到巴黎歌劇院的數位平台「第三舞台」（
3e Scène
）如
何運用影像藝術進行跨界創新。除了戲劇理論與經典導讀外，課程將結合藝術行銷概念，分析法國劇場如何面對當代觀眾的需求，探討其經營管理、資源分配與品牌行銷策略。透過理論與實務案例的交織，學生將能全面理解法國劇場如何平衡傳統保護與現代創新，並具備分析文化產業運作的跨域思考能力。
course.objectives:
課程目標在於引領學生掌握戲劇理論與欣賞，建立對法國戲劇史及當代戲劇發展趨勢的系統性認識，並提升戲劇美學的鑑賞力。進而理解劇場組織文化（例如：理解「常設劇團」與「公共服務」在法國文化政策中的角色）與分析藝術行銷策略（例如：學習劇場如何透過行銷手段與數位創新以吸引年輕受眾觀眾），引發學生對文化管理與表演藝術產業經營的興趣。
期許學習者在完成本課程後，應能達成知識面暨實務面的雙向學習成效目標。在理論上能清楚認識戲劇與劇場基本的理論，並辨識當代法國戲劇的主要趨勢。在實務面能學習初步規劃小型戲劇演出專案或撰寫文化藝術活動行銷企劃的基礎素養，縮短語言學習與職場應用間的距離，並為下學期的閱讀當代劇作家的文本課程以及期末演出做前導教學。

course.description: 盱衡現下，後冷戰時代地緣政治抬頭，全球化的態勢轉趨區域性發展，但各地區仍牽一髮動全身。歐洲自工業革命以降，向以文化霸權自居，此自有其悠久而豐厚的文化與文明底蘊，為了整合並鞏固歐陸強權，遂有歐盟誕生。然而，由於文化歧異、種族多元、宗教衝突、勞動糾紛、難民遷徙、能源爭奪、恐怖主義等問題紛至沓來，不僅造成內部矛盾，外在衝突亦迭有所聞，俄烏戰爭的爆發更將問題推升極致。近年來，甚而有學者和觀察家開始提出歐洲是否面臨困境與衰退。但不論如何，探討歐洲歷來文明與文化問題的來由，唯有追本溯源才是正確的方向。本課程將以單元主題形式，摘取吾人側重之議題，給予不同角度的研讀，期能透過此課程幫助同學整合過往學習基礎，進一步探討歐洲文化與文明之諸多問題，並加以辯證思考。
course.objectives:
一、課程目標：
本課程設計以單元主題為基礎架構，在全球性的視野格局下，透過指定教材內容之研讀，從中摘取關鍵議題，藉以挖掘蘊含於歐洲文化與文明發展中的相關問題。此外，搭配影視教材之交叉印證，期能建立多方視角的討論可能。
本學期主要探討單元主題內容：中世紀專題、工業革命專題、希特勒專題。
二、學習成效：
1) 從關鍵性議題的探討，建立關於歐洲文化與文明之深度思考。
2) 建立批判性觀點，並能有辯證性的思考認知。
3) 具備觀察、分析並統合歐洲各層面訊息之能力，並能深入比較與借鏡。

course.description: Der vorliegende Kurs wird von Dr. Yao Shaoji, Associate Professor der deutschen Sprache an der Abteilung für Europäische Sprachen und Kulturen und dem Journalisten Ilon Huang von der Deutschredaktion von Radio Taiwan International gemeinsam geleitet. Zudem wird er in Zusammenarbeit mit der Abteilung für Deutsch der Universität Osaka in Japan angeboten. Der Kurs zielt darauf ab, den Studierenden durch verschiedene deutschsprachige Medien zu vermitteln, wie deutschsprachige Personen Taiwan verstehen und wahrnehmen, und gleichzeitig zu lernen, wie man auf Deutsch über mit Taiwan verbundene Themen und Personen spricht.
course.objectives:
Das letztendliche Ziel des Sprachenlernens ist die Kommunikation. Neben der Sprache selbst beeinflusst auch das Bewusstsein für kulturelle Unterschiede die Effektivität der Kommunikation. Daher sollten Sprachlerner nicht nur bemüht sein, fremde Kulturen zu verstehen, sondern auch lernen, ihre eigene Kultur in einer Fremdsprache auszudrücken.
Taiwan befindet sich an einer wichtigen strategischen Position in der internationalen Politik und Wirtschaft. Nicht nur die Nachbarländer China und Japan, sondern auch die europäischen und amerikanischen Länder schenken Taiwan stets große Aufmerksamkeit. Auch die deutschsprachigen Länder wie Deutschland, die Schweiz und Österreich bilden da keine Ausnahme. Heute stehen die Beziehungen zwischen den beiden Seiten der Taiwanstraße im Mittelpunkt des Interesses, und Taiwan wird aufgrund seiner Technologiebranche sowie anderer wirtschaftlicher Beziehungen häufig in den Medien der deutschsprachigen Länder thematisiert.
Die Ziele dieses Kurses sind zweifach. Erstens soll den Studierenden durch verschiedene Literatur und deutschsprachige Medien ein Verständnis für Taiwan und dessen internationale Stellung aus der Perspektive deutschsprachiger Personen vermittelt werden. Andererseits sollen die Studierenden in diesem Prozess ihren Wortschatz in Bezug auf die Geschichte und aktuelle Ereignisse Taiwans erweitern und anwenden, um auf Deutsch über ihre Heimatland zu sprechen bzw. zu schreiben. Um diese Ziele zu erreichen, umfasst der Kurs thematische Unterrichtseinheiten und es werden deutschsprachige Personen eingeladen, die schon lange in Taiwan leben oder Taiwan erforschen, um ihre Perspektiven über die Insel zu teilen. Im Lauf des Semesters haben die Studierenden ein Thema im Zusammenhang mit Taiwan zu entwickeln und am Semesterende einen Bericht auf Deutsch zu präsentieren.
Um den Studierenden praktische Übungsmöglichkeiten zu bieten, wird dieser Kurs in Zusammenarbeit mit der Abteilung für Deutsch an der Universität Osaka durchgeführt. Im Verlauf des Semesters sind zwei Online-Veranstaltungen geplant. In der ersten Sitzung stellen sich die Studierenden gegenseitig vor, und anschließend präsentieren sie ihre Heimat (Sehenswürdigkeiten, Geschichte, Essen usw.) und diskutieren ihre Eindrücke vom jeweils anderen Land.
Während eines Besuches in Osaka halten die taiwanischen Studierenden ein Referat auf Deutsch und tauschen sich mit den japanischen Germanistik-Studierenden der Universität Osaka aus.
Die Reise nach Osaka wird für die 10 Teilnehmenden des Kurses bezuschusst, die im Laufe des Kurses (vor dem Besuch in Osaka) die besten Leistungen gezeigt haben. Die Höhe des Zuschusses wird zu Semesterbeginn bekanntgegeben.
Es wird empfohlen, dass die Teilnehmenden des Kurses über Deutschkenntnisse auf dem Niveau A2 oder höher verfügen.

語法

- redact a short article about a theme they are interested on

Mỗi bài học sẽ bao gồm các bài tập thực hành về nghe, nói, đọc và viết tiếng Việt. Hơn nữa, khóa học này sẽ giúp sinh viên nắm bắt những nét độc đáo của văn hóa Việt Nam, cả cổ điển và hiện đại. Tham gia khóa học này, sinh viên sẽ xây dựng được nền tảng sau:
Mục tiêu của khóa học này là nắm vững kiến ​​thức cơ bản về cấu trúc câu, từ vựng và cụm từ thông dụng hàng ngày. Mỗi bài học đều có bài tập thực hành để nâng cao các kỹ năng chính của tiếng Việt. Hơn nữa, mục đích của các bài giảng tiếng Việt là cung cấp cho sinh viên sự hiểu biết về những nét đặc sắc của văn hóa Việt Nam, cả cổ điển và hiện đại. Sau khi hoàn thành khóa học sơ cấp, sinh viên sẽ xây dựng được nền tảng tiếng Việt như sau:
Cách phát âm:
Hiểu biết sâu sắc về hệ thống ngôn ngữ và cấu trúc âm tiết tiếng Việt.
Hiểu sâu sắc hệ thống ngữ âm và cấu trúc âm tiết của nó.
Nó có cách phát âm chuẩn tiếng Việt.
Có khả năng phát âm đúng các từ tiếng Việt.
Từ vựng:
Nắm vững vốn từ vựng cơ bản cho các cuộc hội thoại hàng ngày.
Nắm vững các từ vựng cơ bản trong giao tiếp hàng ngày.
Ngữ pháp:
Các dấu câu (
đã, đang, sẽ
), cấu trúc câu, số, thời gian, ngày tháng, mùa, từ phân loại (
cái, quả, trái, cuốn…
), từ nghi vấn (
khi nào/bao giờ, tại sao, được không
), ...
Các dấu câu (
đã, đang, sẽ
), mẫu câu, số, thời gian, ngày tháng, mùa, từ phân loại (
cái, quả, trái, cuốn…
), từ nghi vấn (
khi nào/bao giờ, tại sao, được không…
)…
Đang nghe:
Nó giúp học sinh nghe và hiểu các cuộc hội thoại cơ bản về các chủ đề quen thuộc, bao gồm từ vựng và ngữ pháp ở trình độ sơ cấp tiếng Việt.
Có khả năng nghe hiểu các cuộc hội thoại cơ bản về các chủ đề quen thuộc trong phạm vi vốn từ vựng và ngữ pháp đã học trong khóa học này.
Nói:
Họ có thể trả lời những câu hỏi đơn giản và tự diễn đạt trong những tình huống quen thuộc.
Có khả năng trả lời các câu hỏi đơn giản và diễn đạt bản thân trong các tình huống quen thuộc.
Đọc:
Họ có thể đọc và hiểu các bài báo ngắn về những chủ đề quen thuộc được viết bằng vốn từ vựng cơ bản.
Có khả năng đọc hiểu các đoạn văn ngắn về những chủ đề quen thuộc hàng ngày được viết bằng vốn từ vựng cơ bản.
Viết:
Họ có khả năng đọc chính tả và viết các câu đơn giản cũng như các bài báo ngắn với vốn từ vựng và ngữ pháp cơ bản hạn chế, chẳng hạn như kế hoạch bốn năm của bản thân hoặc các đoạn văn về công việc hàng ngày.
Có khả năng viết chính tả, câu đơn giản và đoạn văn ngắn về các chủ đề quen thuộc trong giới hạn vốn từ vựng và ngữ pháp cơ bản - ví dụ: chủ đề kế hoạch tương lai, thói quen hàng ngày…
Kiến thức văn hóa:
Tìm hiểu kiến ​​thức văn hóa tổng quát bằng cách sử dụng tiếng Việt cơ bản, chẳng hạn như giá trị văn hóa của các lễ hội và bài hát Việt Nam.
Nắm vững kiến ​​thức văn hóa tổng quát thông qua việc sử dụng tiếng Việt ở trình độ cơ bản, bao gồm các phong tục, cách diễn đạt văn hóa, các ngày lễ quốc gia, thành ngữ Việt Nam…
Trình độ tiếng Việt:
Những học sinh hoàn thành chương trình học thành công sẽ được cấp chứng chỉ A1
(trình độ tiền tiểu học)  .

course.description:
本課程透過越語文化特色讓學生發掘四項初階語言技巧。課程著重加強對話技巧與學習實用語法及口語表達之詞彙。
This course is designed to develop four major linguistic skills at the basic level together with cultural characteristics reflected in the Vietnamese language. This class is emphasized on the enhancement of conversation skills, learning practical grammar and vocabulary in spoken language competencies.
course.objectives:
本課程著重提升學生越語口說與流暢溝通，並強調每日一字、發音及句型練習，運用簡短對話討論各種主題。選修本課程，學生將建立以下基礎：
The focus of the course is to improve students’ confidence in Vietnamese speaking and communicating effectively. The main purpose of this class is to provide everyday vocabulary, pronunciation, and sentence patterns and to enable to carry out simple conversations on various topics. By the end of the semester, students will obtain as follow:
發音
Pronunciation:
不經由老師輔助，運用適當的音調正確發音押韻與詞彙。
Pronounce rhymes and words correctly with appropriate tones without the teacher’s support.
詞彙
Vocabulary:
增加日常對話詞彙量。
Obtain extended basic vocabulary in daily conversations.
理解諺語及格言等傳統說法。
Be able to understand folk words in proverbs and sayings.
辨別南北越的詞彙。
Distinguish vocabulary by Vietnam North-South regions.
文法
Grammar:
- 深入理解人稱代名詞、代名詞、基本用法和簡單句型，例如“主語+謂語”。
Understand in-depth the knowledge of personal pronoun, pronoun, basic usage, and simple sentence patterns-for example, “Subject + predicate”.
- 關於職業、國籍、語言，點餐，購物，習慣與嗜好方面的問題
Questions about occupations, nationality, languages, ordering food，shopping, habits and hobbies,  …
- 增加口語文法結構，所需詞彙。
Obtain extended grammar structures, the use of vocabulary used in spoken language.
- 疑問詞(
à, gì, nào
…)、介詞(
của,ở,tại
…)、量詞(
người, đứa, kẻ
…)、助詞(
đấy, thế, nhé, ừ
)、情態動詞(
muốn, có thể, cần, phải, nên
) 、感嘆詞(
ơi
) 、語氣詞 (
cơ/ kia
) 、比較副詞(
bằng, hơn, nhất
)用法…等
Interrogative words (
à, gì, nào
…); prepositions (
của, ở,tại
…); classifiers (
người,đứa,kẻ
…); final particles (
đấy, thế, nhé,ừ
); modal verbs (
muốn, có thể, cần, phải, nên
); interjection (
ơi
), modal particle (
cơ
); adverb of comparison (
bằng, hơn, nhất
)…
聽力
Listening:
能夠傾聽與理解熟悉的主題之基本對話，包含初級越語，初級越語會話範圍中的詞彙和語法。
Be able to listen and comprehend spoken discourse in familiar topics within the limits of vocabulary and grammar.
口說
Speaking:
在日常對話中用適當的語調交談，在熟悉的情境中表達自我。
Converse with appropriate tones in daily life conversations and express oneself in familiar situations.
閱讀
Reading:
在詞彙量範圍內閱讀和辨識日常生活主題口語表達意思。
Read and identify the purpose of spoken texts in daily life topics within the limits of vocabulary.
寫作
Writing:
能夠在基礎詞彙和語法範圍內，於熟悉主題中撰寫更長的句子，段落與文化報告，例如自我介紹、旅遊經驗段落等。
Be able to write longer sentences, passages, and cultural reports in familiar topics within the limit of basic vocabulary and grammar-for example, self-introduction, travel experience…
文化知識
Cultural knowledge:
透過使用基礎生活用語獲取文化知識, 例如家庭關係、飲食文化方式等。
Acquire cultural knowledge through the use of spoken Vietnamese language at a basic level with regards to the family relationship, the cultural manner of eating and drinking, …
越語檢定標準
Vietnamese language proficiency level:
達到A1(初級標準)
Be able to acquire A1 (Pre-elementary level)

course.description:
本課程延續初級越語課程、進一步發掘聽、說、讀、寫的中階技巧與更深入的越南文化。本課程著重於現今越南日常生活的各個面向，為學生提供更穩固的越南語基礎。
The course is a continuation of elementary Vietnamese, which is further to develop the integrated skills of listening, speaking, reading, and writing at the intermediate level, together with a deeper understanding of Vietnamese culture. The lessons have focused on various aspects of the life of present-day Vietnam, in order to provide students with a solid foundation in using Vietnamese.
course.objectives:
本課程將運用大量新詞彙和文法掌握的延伸，有效幫助學生運用 口說及寫作交流廣泛的議題。選修本課程，學生將建立以下基礎：
The course provides a wide range of new vocabulary and extended grasp of grammar with the aim to help students use Vietnamese effectively on a broad range of topics in both oral and written communication. On the completion of this course, students will be able to:
發音 Pronunciation:
- 擁有完美的越南語發音。
Obtain the goal of perfect Vietnamese language pronunciation.
詞彙 Vocabulary:
- 增加口說與寫作詞彙量
Obtain extended vocabulary in both spoken and written language.
- 獲得學術、文化和社會中運用的新詞彙。
Gain new vocabulary used in academic learning, culture, and society.
- 辨認純越語、漢越詞、外來詞或混種詞等詞彙類型之不同處。
Distinguish types of vocabulary which are pure Vietnamese or Sino-Vietnamese or loanwords or mixed words.
文法 Grammar:
- 掌握片語與混合句之用法，如 “
sở dĩ… là vì”, “cả…lẫn…”, “nhờ…mà…”, “cho dù…đi chăng nữa…”, “A dẫn đến/ khiếncho/ làm cho B
”等.
Acquire knowledge of the usage of complex phrases and mixedsentences -for example,
“sở dĩ… là vì”, “cả…lẫn…”, “ nhờ…mà…”, “cho dù…đi chăng nữa…”, “A dẫn đến/ khiến cho/làm cho B”
...
聽力 Listening:
- 能夠在各種情況下傾聽和理解連貫的對話，包含初級越語, 初級越語會話, 中級越語範圍中的詞彙和語法。
Be able to listen and comprehend coherent conversations in diverse situations within the limits of vocabulary and grammar.
口 說 Speaking:
- 運用準確的發音和自然的表達，習得交流資訊和經驗。
Acquire Vietnamese language possibility to exchange information and experience with accurate pronunciation and natural expressions in Vietnamese.
閱讀 Reading:
- 能夠閱讀和理解越南報紙、雜誌和書籍的摘要資訊。
Be able to read and grasp the summary information which is drawn from Vietnamese newspapers, magazines, and books.
寫作 Writing:
- 透過使用片語和混合句子書寫信件、電子郵件和演講稿，例如，給老師的一封信，關於自己最喜歡的城市的介紹等。
Write letters, emails, and presentations through the use of complex phrases and mixed sentences-for example, a letter to teacher, an introduction about your favorite city …
文化知識 Cultural knowledge:
- 運用中級越語學習地區文化、越南中醫，等的文化知識。
Acquire cultural knowledge through the use of Vietnamese language at the intermediate level with regards to cultural regions, Vietnamese traditional medicine, Xích Lô cyclo…
越語檢定標準 Vietnamese language proficiency level:
- 達到B1(初-中級標準)
Successful students will be able to reach B1 (Pre-intermediate)

course.titleEn: Understanding Southeast Asia: Development and Governance
course.department: 東南越一東南泰一東南印一東南越二東南泰二東南印二
course.description: This course generally offers a wider introduction to understanding Southeast Asia as a region. It begins by highlighting reasons for exploring the dynamics of international relations in the region and the importance these have contributed to contemporary global politics. Earlier historical developments are revisited and traced as part of efforts in understanding contemporary development within the region. The Association of South East Asian Nations (ASEAN) as the main regional organization within the region is also explored. Meanwhile, other important issues that shape the dynamics of international relations in Southeast Asia are also looked at. These issues range from economic development strategies, security and conflict resolution mechanisms, environmental degradation, migration, and human rights and human security issues.
course.objectives: After completing this course, students are expected to generally understand the contemporary dynamics of development in Southeast Asia, be able to identify key issues shaping these dynamics, and understand factors that have contributed to the contemporary dynamics of regional interactions in Southeast Asia.

course.description:
Khóa học dành cho người mới bắt đầu này nhằm cung cấp cho học viên những kiến ​​thức cơ bản về ngữ âm tiếng Việt và các điểm ngữ pháp thực tiễn. Song song với các khóa học Tiếng
Việt cơ bản
và
Hội thoại tiếng Việt cơ bản
, nơi các đoạn hội thoại đơn giản, đoạn văn đọc hiểu và các quy tắc ngữ pháp cơ bản được dạy theo từng chủ đề cụ thể nhưng không có hệ thống, điều này dẫn đến sự nhầm lẫn trong nhiều trường hợp; do đó, khóa học này nỗ lực giới thiệu cách thức hoạt động của tiếng Việt một cách có hệ thống thông qua các bài tập và bài thực hành khác nhau.
course.objectives:
Mục tiêu của khóa học này là nắm vững hệ thống ngữ âm tiếng Việt, bao gồm bảng chữ cái, cấu trúc âm tiết và ngữ điệu. Khóa học nhằm giúp người học hiểu được những đặc điểm vốn có của từ tiếng Việt (các loại từ, cấu tạo từ và nguyên âm, cụm từ). Cuối cùng, khóa học giúp xây dựng các thành phần của câu tiếng Việt (câu đơn và câu ghép).
Mỗi bài học đều có các bài tập thực hành nhằm nâng cao bốn kỹ năng của tiếng Việt. Sau khi hoàn thành khóa học sơ cấp, học viên sẽ xây dựng được nền tảng tiếng Việt như sau:
Cách phát âm
:
Hiểu sâu sắc hệ thống ngữ âm và cấu trúc âm tiết của nó.
Có khả năng phát âm đúng các từ tiếng Việt.
Từ vựng
:
Nắm vững các từ cơ bản trong hội thoại hàng ngày:
mình, nhau, ai, gì, những/các, được/bị
…
Ngữ pháp
:
Mẫu câu:
Vì…nên…, Do…mà…,…vừa…vừa…,…có…mới…, không/chưa/kết
+ động từ/ tính từ…
Nghe
:
Có khả năng nghe hiểu các cuộc hội thoại cơ bản về các chủ đề quen thuộc trong phạm vi vốn từ vựng và ngữ pháp đã học trong khóa học này.
Nói
:
Có khả năng trả lời các câu hỏi đơn giản và diễn đạt bản thân trong các tình huống quen thuộc.
Đọc
:
Có khả năng đọc hiểu các đoạn văn ngắn về những chủ đề quen thuộc hàng ngày được viết bằng vốn từ vựng cơ bản.
Viết
:
Có khả năng viết chính tả, câu đơn giản và đoạn văn ngắn về các chủ đề quen thuộc trong phạm vi vốn từ vựng và ngữ pháp cơ bản.
Trình độ tiếng
Việt :
Những học sinh hoàn thành chương trình học thành công sẽ đạt được trình độ A1 (trình độ tiền tiểu học).

course.description:
The Vietnamese Thematic Composition course is designed for students who have intermediate-level
Vietnamese writing skills. The course provides students with fundamental knowledge and skills in
interactive and academic writing, with a particular focus on Vietnamese text structure. It also offers
guidance on writing professional Vietnamese documents through hands-on practice with commonly used
forms such as: Báo cáo, Giấy cam đoan, Đơn xin nghỉ phép, Hợp đồng mua bán hàng hóa, Bản ghi nhớ
hợp tác, Đơn trình báo,..
This course helps students develop advanced Vietnamese writing skills and apply what they have learned
to various tasks such as letter writing, email composition, opinion essays (topic-based writing), and
drafting common Vietnamese administrative documents relevant to both professional and everyday
contexts.
course.objectives:
This course equips students with fundamental knowledge of Vietnamese texts and common
administrative document formats. It also provides essential knowledge related to work, commerce, law,
and relevant issues.
 Students will acquire key sentence structures and core vocabulary commonly used in administrative texts. Based on this foundation, they will be able to apply grammatical structures and learned vocabulary
to the composition of frequently used administrative documents.
 Through practice in drafting various types of documents, students will develop advanced Vietnamese
writing skills. By the end of the course, they will be able to write a wide range of practical documents
fluently in Vietnamese. In particular, students will be capable of performing well in both interactive and
academic writing tasks required by the Vietnamese Language Proficiency Test for foreigners issued by the
Ministry of Education and Training of Vietnam. The students' Vietnamese proficiency level upon course
completion is equivalent to levels B2 to C2 (levels 4 to 6) according to the 6-level Vietnamese Language
Proficiency Framework for foreigners.

course.description:
Advanced Vietnamese: Literature
is a course for students who have Intermediate Vietnamese level for Vietnamese reading comprehension skills. The course includes 14 lessons, providing students with foundational understanding of Vietnamese literature, from Folk literature to Contemporary literature through typical works of different genres. Regarding Folk literature, students practice reading and comprehension skills of works in the genre of proverbs and idioms; myths, legends, fairy tales, fables,… Regarding Modern literature, the course introduces the works of some typical writers of the Doi moi period such as: “Reed Grass” by Nguyen Minh Chau, “Salt of the Forest” by Nguyen Huy Thiep. Students will be able to develop and advance their Vietnamese reading comprehension abilities through literature.
course.objectives:
Objective:
Provide international students a foundational and advanced understanding of Vietnamese language, the relationship between literature and language, as well as the elementary knowledge of Vietnamese literature through typical works from folk literature to literature contemporary.
The course provides students with knowledge and skills/theory and practice on the method of Reading Comprehension a complete Vietnamese text in the field of literature: method of finding keywords, main ideas, content of each paragraph in the text as well as the theme of the entire work; Analyze the diverse meanings of closely linked language groupings in order to achieve high efficiency in reading comprehension and analyzing the meaning of the text.
Learning Outcomes:
After completing the course, students will be able to:
- Master reading and understanding Vietnamese texts, present the content and theme of the text, and apply it to reading Vietnamese literary works.
- Understand the relationship between literature and language, between Vietnamese language and Vietnamese literature and basic knowledge of Vietnamese literature through typical literary works.
-Students understand the content and meaning of literary works selected in the program; can write a presentation introducing a specific author and literary work; can use folk proverbs in communication - speaking and writing.
- Through the course, students will accumulate a rich knowledge of literature, and at the same time have access to emotional expressions of artistic texts, in order to practice and improve their reading and comprehension skills. Advanced level Vietnamese writing skills.
Through the content and meaning of literary works, students will have a deeper understanding of the country, people, history and culture of Vietnam.

course.description:
泰國自古以來位於東南亞貿易中心，陸地與緬甸、寮國、柬埔寨、馬來西亞等鄰近國家接壤，有水路通國際海峽。在觀光及市場貿易極受歡迎、萬眾矚目，吸引不少臺灣人到泰國旅遊與投資設工廠，甚至到泰國去工作、退休後定居。
語言是文化的載體，互相了解彼此文化，能促進兩國的良好友誼關係，不論是教育、經濟、技術、醫療、宗教等方面的交流，皆需要透過語言來完成。但是僅僅能掌握語言的使用是不夠的，在精進語言能力的同時，也需要深入及全面性地了解該語言的文化與社會的歷史脈絡，及文化社會下所形成的價值觀。如此一來才能更好地在語言的使用中理解母語者的語言思維模式，除了能精準地理解與使用該語言之外，更能避免與母語者交流時犯到該文化的禁忌、而被誤以為冒犯，進而建立良好的跨文化交流。
Thailand has been located in the trading center of Southeast Asia since ancient times, sharing borders with neighboring countries such as Myanmar, Laos, Cambodia, and Malaysia. It has waterways to international straits, making it a popular destination for tourism and market trade.
Language is the carrier of culture, and mutual understanding of each other's culture can promote good friendship between countries. Whether it is in education, economics, technology, medicine, religion, or other fields, exchanges must be completed through language. However, it is not enough to simply master the use of the language. In addition to improving language skills, it is also necessary to gain an in-depth and comprehensive understanding of the cultural and social history of the language and the values formed in the cultural society. This way, we can better understand the native speakers' linguistic patterns of thought in using the language. By understanding and using the language accurately, we can avoid cultural taboos and being misunderstood as offensive when communicating with native speakers, thus establishing good cross-cultural communication.
course.objectives:
能更好地在語言的使用中理解母語者的語言思維模式，除了能精準地理解與使用該語言之外，更能避免與母語者交流時犯到該文化的禁忌、而被誤以為冒犯，進而建立良好的跨文化交流。
By understanding and using the language accurately, we can avoid cultural taboos and being misunderstood as offensive when communicating with native speakers, thus establishing good cross-cultural communication.

course.description:
Advanced Thai Grammar and Composition
is an upper-level Thai language course designed for learners who have attained an intermediate to upper-intermediate proficiency (approximately CEFR B2–C1) and wish to develop advanced competence in academic reading and writing. The course emphasizes the integrated development of grammatical accuracy, discourse organization, and stylistic appropriateness through authentic Thai texts representing historical, cultural, literary, and contemporary topics.
Students will engage with a variety of text genres, including historical essays, cultural narratives, formal correspondence, literary excerpts, argumentative essays, and contemporary academic discussions. Through close reading, grammatical analysis, and guided writing practice, students will learn to identify advanced linguistic structures, organize coherent arguments, and produce well-developed written Thai suitable for both academic and professional contexts.
The course also places particular emphasis on the writing process, including planning, drafting, revising, and editing. By the end of the semester, students will be able to produce clear, coherent, and stylistically appropriate compositions while demonstrating an advanced command of Thai grammar, vocabulary, and discourse conventions.
course.objectives:
Course Goals
Upon successful completion of this course, students will be able to:
Develop an advanced understanding of Thai grammatical structures and their application in formal written communication.
Strengthen reading comprehension through the analysis of authentic Thai texts from historical, cultural, literary, and contemporary contexts.
Produce coherent and well-organized written compositions across multiple genres, including descriptive, narrative, expository, argumentative, and formal correspondence.
Apply appropriate language registers and stylistic conventions according to different communicative purposes and audiences.
Develop critical thinking through textual analysis, discussion, and evidence-based writing.
Improve revision and self-editing skills to produce grammatically accurate and stylistically effective written Thai.
Learning Outcomes
By the end of the course, students will be able to:
Analyze
advanced Thai texts by identifying their grammatical structures, discourse organization, rhetorical strategies, and stylistic features.
Apply
advanced grammatical patterns, cohesive devices, and discourse markers accurately in academic and professional writing.
Compose
descriptive, narrative, expository, argumentative, and formal written texts that demonstrate logical organization, coherence, and grammatical accuracy.
Differentiate
between informal, semi-formal, formal, literary, and academic registers, and employ each appropriately in writing.
Evaluate
and revise their own writing and that of peers by improving grammatical accuracy, lexical precision, coherence, and overall communicative effectiveness.
Integrate
information from reading and listening materials to produce well-supported summaries, reflections, and analytical compositions in advanced Thai.
Demonstrate
critical engagement with Thai historical, cultural, literary, and contemporary issues through evidence-based written responses and class discussions.
These outcomes align well with an advanced Thai language course at the undergraduate level and support the progression toward CEFR
B2–C1
proficiency, with particular emphasis on academic literacy and advanced written communication.

course.description:
Introduction to Indonesian Culture and Society
is designed to provide students with a foundational understanding of Indonesia's diverse cultures, society, and ways of life. Through a range of thematic topics, students will explore the country's cultural diversity, social values, historical and contemporary developments, traditions, religions, arts, languages, and everyday practices. By examining these topics, students will develop intercultural awareness and gain a deeper understanding of how Indonesian people live, interact, and shape their communities in a multicultural society. The course encourages students to critically reflect on Indonesia's cultural and social dynamics while appreciating the country's rich diversity from both local and global perspectives.

Demonstrate a foundational understanding of Indonesian culture, society, and contemporary social issues.

Analyze and discuss selected topics related to Indonesian culture and society through class discussions and presentations.
Write well-organized essays and deliver oral presentations on assigned topics related to Indonesian culture and society.
Compare and critically reflect on the cultural and social characteristics of Indonesia and Taiwan, identifying both similarities and differences while demonstrating intercultural awareness.
Teaching and Learning Methods
The course will be delivered through a combination of lectures, class discussions, student presentations, audiovisual materials, and other interactive learning activities designed to promote critical thinking, intercultural understanding, and active participation.

course.description:
This course explores the dynamic landscape of post-1998 Indonesian popular culture as a window into understanding contemporary Indonesian society. Students will critically examine how democratic transition, market capitalism, the rise of Islam, and digital technology shape identity, language, music, film, and lifestyle in Southeast Asia's largest economy.
The course bridges formal linguistic knowledge with natural social realities. A distinctive comparative approach will be applied to analyze transnational pop culture flows and the cultural presence of the Indonesian diaspora in Taiwan. Through an ethnolinguistic approach, multimodal microlearning, and student-centered seminar discussions, students will master informal language structures while developing critical intercultural communication competencies.
course.objectives:
Course Goal:
This course aims to equip upper-intermediate students with the necessary critical and analytical skills to speak, deconstruct, and utilize advanced informal Indonesian popular discourse effectively in diverse social contexts, while fostering a comprehensive, pluricultural understanding of post-1998 socio-cultural and transnational nuances (BIPA B2 level).
Learning Outcomes:
By the end of the semester, students will be able to:
Linguistic Competence: Present, discuss, and apply advanced informal Indonesian language structures, including slang, acronyms, and urban code-mixing (Bahasa Anak Jaksel) accurately in appropriate real-time social interactions.
Sociolinguistics & Screen Analysis: Deconstruct sociopolitical narratives, historical trauma, religious values, and gender representation in contemporary Indonesian cinema, particularly folk horror and Islamic romance.
Cross-Cultural Fluency: Analyze the social history and commercialization of Indonesian popular music genres, confidently comparing the aesthetics of Dangdut Koplo with Taiwan’s Taike (台客) culture sensibilities.
Empirical Research Competence: Conduct independent digital or physical field ethnography reports, mapping out and retelling the dynamics of Indonesian diaspora spaces and cultural interactions within Taiwan.
Collaborative Digital Literacy: Collaborate effectively in teams to produce public-facing digital media projects (mini-documentaries, podcasts, or digital curations) as a practical reflection of advanced language and communicative competence.

course.titleZh: 東南亞社會與文化中的基督宗教
course.titleEn: Christianity in the Southeast Asian Context
course.department: 東南越三東南泰三東南印三東南越四東南泰四東南印四
course.description:
宗教除了超越性的向度，也具現世性和臨在性，因此種種關於宗教的認識和詮釋均無法脫離所處脈絡。宗教在東南亞社會扮演重要角色，其政教關係、宗教間的關係以及所謂的「宗教自由」往往不是相對世俗化、自由宗教市場的台灣社會的脈絡所能理解。另一方面，社會系統其實受一個獨立的文化系統塑造和控制，文化體系是價值觀、符號、信仰的複雜交織體，宗教正是價值觀、符號、信仰的集合，因而與文化交織。基督宗教雖被認為來自西方，但已深植本土，且是東南亞某些國家為人所知的元素之一。
早在伊斯蘭傳入東南亞地區以先，基督宗教的亞述東方教會在七世紀就已進入馬來半島和蘇門答臘北部，然而十三到十五世紀，伊斯蘭開始在馬來世界（Nusantara）發展，基督宗教早期據點逐漸消失。歐洲大航海時代揭開序幕以後，天主教隨著葡萄牙殖民勢力進入，與伊斯蘭在這塊區域展開傳教競爭。在1557年佔領澳門後，葡萄牙以此為中心向交趾支那（越南）、高棉、暹羅傳教。而後新教海權國家荷蘭、英國等也挾其殖民勢力在東南亞傳教。對東南亞許多國家而言，基督宗教與殖民勢力可謂緊密相關，但也代表某種現代性；而在一些海洋東南亞國家，伊斯蘭被視為反殖民的力量，與基督宗教迥然有別，因此產生某種對立。在二戰後紛紛獨立的東南亞國家的社會和文化處境下，與殖民勢力相關的基督宗教扮演什麼樣的角色？還有今日強調非西方的「世界基督教」（World Christianity）研究視野下，在不同的東南亞國家，基督宗教又產生何種多元性和在地性？
一般論及東南亞與宗教時少有涉及基督宗教，然而基督宗教在許多東南亞國家往往是第二或第三大宗教（在菲律賓和東帝汶更是人數最多的宗教），且具影響力，在某些地方更是身份認同的象徵。
作為宗教研究所和東南亞文化與宗教跨領域學程一部分，本課程將先概述東南亞歷史文化，並讓同學對基督宗教有基本認識，之後分別探討幾個東南亞國家的基督宗教概況以及與社會和文化有關的議題、案例。此外，本課程也預計籌劃校外參訪，認識在本地的東南亞基督宗教群體。
course.objectives: 國人一般提及東南亞的宗教，如數家珍的不外乎上座部佛教、伊斯蘭、印度教。除提及菲律賓，基督宗教往往被忽視。本課程具東南亞文化和世界宗教通識的意義，嘗試以基督宗教為切入點認識東南亞的社會與文化，同時也期盼提升修讀者對基督宗教及其現況的基礎認識，尤其是它在世界各地的多元性與異質性，單以西方基督宗教為模版已不足夠。另外，基於特殊時空脈絡所致東南亞各國各族文化在台灣的落戶與交融，台灣社會將來可望具備較諸其他東亞國家更傑出的東南亞文化識讀潛力。作為現代公民，相信培養多元文化視野以及對世界宗教的認識將是不可或缺的一環，本課程盼望能承擔部分責任。

course.description:
AI時代多語多文化非典型語言教學探索
115-1
Unconventional Multilingual and Multicultural Pedagogy in the AI Era
This course focuses on
unconventional, decentralized, and embodied approaches
to multilingual and multicultural pedagogy. In an era when Generative AI can instantly translate, correct grammar, and simulate basic conversation, the notion that language teaching must move beyond traditional classroom instruction prevails. If this is the case, it is necessary to examine how informal language teaching has been practiced, what challenges there might be, and how related issues can emerge, with the mediation of GenAI, digital technology, or other unconventional forms of language learning experience.
在生成式 AI 可以即時翻譯、修正語法和模擬基本對話的時代，有人認為語言教學必須超越傳統課堂教學。若真如此，就有必要檢視目前的「非正式語言教學」樣貌：也就是說，本課程的討論聚焦於在生成式 AI、數位科技或其他非傳統學習經驗的媒介下，非學校、非課室語言教學的實施、挑戰、與其他相關議題。
course.objectives:
By qualitatively investigating alternative learning spaces, such as language tables, theatrical performances, online learning, social media, and gamified language teaching, students will critically evaluate the role of GenAI while designing human-centric educational interventions that prioritize cultural identity, affect, and bodily presence in language education.
修讀本課程的同學會一起探索多語多文化教學中具有
非典型
、
學習者中心化
、
身體力行
特色的語言教學實踐
。透過探究替代性學習空間，例如語言桌、戲劇表演、線上學習、社群媒體、遊戲化、社區性質的語言教學，學習如何以語言教學質性研究方法批判性地評估這些非典型語言教學，深入生成式 AI 在其中的作用與角色，並在優先考慮文化認同、情意、身體力行的狀況下，設計以人為中心的AI輔助語言教學方法。

course.description:
Pioneered by Longinus, codified by Nicholas Boileau and John Dennis, and popularised by Burke and Kant, the sublime, with its powerful emotions and overwhelming effects, provides rich loam for Romantic writers and artists to cultivate the (meta)physical sense of wonder or terror in their glorification of the natural or of the supernatural. This course aims to explore the impact of the sublime on the verbal and visual works of the Romantic era (particularly in England). We will begin by
examining foundational writings on the sublime from Longinus to Kant to understand the traits of the sublime and its development. We will then examine how major Romantic painters and writers engage with the sublime—directly or indirectly—positioning this aesthetic concept as a cardinal emblem of the Romantic movement and a vital framework for representing today’s environmental crisis. By the end of this course, students will be able to explain major theories of the sublime in relation to Romanticism and develop an original research argument suitable for conference presentation or publication.
